WITH sat_excellence_schools AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode
  FROM satscores
  WHERE NumTstTakr > 0 AND (NumGE1500 * 1.0 / NumTstTakr) > 0.3
)

SELECT MAX(frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)]) AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN sat_excellence_schools s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)] IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    F.[District Code],
    F.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)]
FROM frpm F
JOIN schools S ON F.CDSCode = S.CDSCode
WHERE S.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine'
LIMIT 1000;

WITH HighScorerSchools AS (
  SELECT cds AS school_cds, SUM(NumGE1500) AS high_scorers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
MaxHighScorers AS (
  SELECT MAX(high_scorers) AS max_score
  FROM HighScorerSchools
),
TopHighScorerSchools AS (
  SELECT school_cds
  FROM HighScorerSchools, MaxHighScorers
  WHERE high_scorers = max_score
),
StatewideBenefitCharterSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
)
SELECT s.School AS school_name, s.Phone AS phone_number
FROM schools s
JOIN TopHighScorerSchools t ON s.CDSCode = t.school_cds
JOIN StatewideBenefitCharterSchools sbc ON sbc.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
LIMIT 1000;

WITH direct_funded AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1611190130609'
    AND FundingType = 'Directly-funded charter school'
), sat_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
         SUM(NumTstTakr) AS students_took_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '1611190130609'
)
SELECT avg_math_score, students_took_sat
FROM sat_stats
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM direct_funded);

WITH reference AS (
  SELECT cds, NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
), 
schools_ahead AS (
  SELECT s.cds
  FROM satscores s, reference r
  WHERE s.NumTstTakr > r.NumTstTakr
    AND s.cds LIKE '76%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_ahead_count
FROM schools_ahead;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND s.DOCType IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
  AND (sa.AvgScrRead + sa.AvgScrMath + sa.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500;

WITH GradeStarts AS (
  SELECT
    NCESDist,
    TRIM(SUBSTR(GSoffered, 1, INSTR(GSoffered, '-') - 1)) AS start_grade
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSoffered IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(CASE 
            WHEN start_grade = 'P' THEN 0
            WHEN start_grade = 'K' THEN 0
            ELSE CAST(start_grade AS INTEGER)
           END) AS lowest_grade_level
FROM GradeStarts;

WITH StateBoardSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, AdmEmail1
  FROM schools
  WHERE DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
),
HighScorers AS (
  SELECT cds, NumGE1500
  FROM satscores
)

SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1
FROM StateBoardSchools s
JOIN HighScorers h ON s.CDSCode = h.cds
WHERE h.NumGE1500 = (
  SELECT MAX(NumGE1500)
  FROM HighScorers h2
  JOIN StateBoardSchools s2 ON h2.cds = s2.CDSCode
)

WITH MiddleSchools AS (
  SELECT
    schools.SOCType AS SchoolType,
    schools.School AS SchoolName,
    schools.Latitude
  FROM schools
  WHERE (schools.SOCType LIKE '%middle%' OR 
         schools.School LIKE '%middle%')
)

SELECT SchoolType, SchoolName, Latitude
FROM MiddleSchools
WHERE Latitude = (SELECT MAX(Latitude) FROM MiddleSchools);

WITH LA_2007_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'Los Angeles'
    AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2007-12-31'
    AND District IS NOT NULL
), SAT_counts AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, COALESCE(SUM(sc.NumTstTakr), 0) AS total_takers
  FROM LA_2007_schools s
  LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  GROUP BY s.CDSCode
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM SAT_counts;

WITH ClosedSchools AS (
  SELECT sc.School AS name, sc.District AS district, sc.County AS county, sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_writing
  FROM satscores sa
  JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed' AND sa.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
RankedScores AS (
  SELECT avg_sat_writing, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_sat_writing DESC) AS score_rank
  FROM ClosedSchools
  GROUP BY avg_sat_writing
)
SELECT name, district, county, avg_sat_writing
FROM ClosedSchools
WHERE avg_sat_writing IN (SELECT avg_sat_writing FROM RankedScores WHERE score_rank = 2)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH ActiveHighSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
    AND GSoffered LIKE '%High School%'
    AND State = 'CA'
),
SATCounts AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
SchoolsWithZeroSAT AS (
  SELECT A.CDSCode
  FROM ActiveHighSchools A
  LEFT JOIN SATCounts S ON A.CDSCode = S.cds
  WHERE COALESCE(S.total_test_takers, 0) = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_sat_schools_count
FROM SchoolsWithZeroSAT;

WITH FremontCounty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT [County Code], [County Name]
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
),
FilteredSchools AS (
  SELECT f.[CDSCode], f.[Enrollment (K-12)], f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)], f.[FRPM Count (K-12)], f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS charter_ind,
         ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS free_meal_pct,
         ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)], 2) AS frpm_pct,
         f.[County Code], f.[County Name]
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN FremontCounty fc ON fc.[County Code] = f.[County Code]
  WHERE f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500 AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
),
SATScoresBySchool AS (
  SELECT s.cds, (COALESCE(s.AvgScrRead,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrMath,0) + COALESCE(s.AvgScrWrite,0)) AS sat_sum
  FROM satscores s
)
SELECT 
  fs.[County Name],
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.free_meal_pct), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(fs.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter_ind = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_school_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fs.charter_ind = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_school_count,
  ROUND(AVG(sat.sat_sum), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM FilteredSchools fs
LEFT JOIN SATScoresBySchool sat ON fs.CDSCode = sat.cds
GROUP BY fs.[County Code], fs.[County Name];

WITH opened_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', OpenDate) AS year,
    strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS schools_opened
  FROM schools
  WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
    AND County = 'San Diego'
    AND District IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year, month
),
months AS (
  SELECT '01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT '02' UNION ALL SELECT '03' UNION ALL SELECT '04' UNION ALL SELECT '05' UNION ALL SELECT '06' UNION ALL SELECT '07' UNION ALL SELECT '08' UNION ALL SELECT '09' UNION ALL SELECT '10' UNION ALL SELECT '11' UNION ALL SELECT '12'
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(COALESCE(opened_schools.schools_opened, 0)) AS avg_opened_per_month
  FROM months
  LEFT JOIN opened_schools ON months.month = opened_schools.month
  WHERE opened_schools.year = '1980' OR opened_schools.year IS NULL
)
SELECT avg_opened_per_month FROM avgs;

WITH HighMathSchools AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
  WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND sa.AvgScrMath > 400
),
VirtualSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual IN ('F', 'P')
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN hs.CDSCode IS NOT NULL AND vs.CDSCode IS NOT NULL THEN hs.CDSCode END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT hs.CDSCode), 1) AS pct_virtual
FROM HighMathSchools hs
LEFT JOIN VirtualSchools vs ON hs.CDSCode = vs.CDSCode;

SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.County AS county,
    s.District AS district,
    s.City AS city,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12,
    CAST(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS TEXT) AS percent_frpm_k12,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS sat_avg_reading_score,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS sat_avg_math_score,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS sat_avg_writing_score,
    sat.NumGE1500 AS sat_test_takers_1500_plus
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943'
LIMIT 1

WITH SchoolList AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved, Charter, County
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'Alameda' AND (GSserved LIKE '%12%')
), FreeMealRates AS (
  SELECT [School Code] AS CDSCode, 
         [Free Meal Count (K-12)] / [Enrollment (K-12)] AS FreeMealRate
  FROM frpm
  WHERE [Enrollment (K-12)] > 0
), SATLevels AS (
  SELECT cds,
    CASE 
      WHEN (AvgScrRead IS NULL OR AvgScrMath IS NULL OR AvgScrWrite IS NULL) THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS SATPerfLevel
  FROM satscores
), MaxFreeMealRate AS (
  SELECT MAX(fmr.FreeMealRate) AS MaxRate
  FROM FreeMealRates fmr
  JOIN SchoolList sl ON fmr.CDSCode = sl.CDSCode
)
SELECT
  sl.School AS SchoolName,
  ROUND(fmr.FreeMealRate,4) AS FreeMealRate,
  CASE WHEN sl.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN sl.Charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS IsCharter,
  sl.GSserved AS GradesServed,
  COALESCE(sl2.SATPerfLevel, 'No SAT Data') AS SATPerformanceLevel
FROM SchoolList sl
JOIN FreeMealRates fmr ON sl.CDSCode = fmr.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN SATLevels sl2 ON sl.CDSCode = sl2.cds
JOIN MaxFreeMealRate mfr ON fmr.FreeMealRate = mfr.MaxRate
ORDER BY sl.School
LIMIT 1000;

WITH VirtualSchools AS (
  SELECT
    County AS county,
    School AS school_name
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
), 
SchoolReadingScores AS (
  SELECT
    sname AS school_name,
    AVG(CAST(AvgScrRead AS FLOAT)) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sname
),
CountyVirtualCount AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
  FROM VirtualSchools
  GROUP BY county
),
RankedCounties AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    virtual_school_count,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS rank
  FROM CountyVirtualCount
),
TopCounties AS (
  SELECT county, virtual_school_count
  FROM RankedCounties
  WHERE rank <= (
    SELECT rank
    FROM RankedCounties
    ORDER BY rank
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 4
  )
),
CountySchoolsWithScores AS (
  SELECT
    v.county,
    v.school_name,
    COALESCE(s.avg_reading_score, NULL) AS avg_reading_score
  FROM VirtualSchools v
  LEFT JOIN SchoolReadingScores s ON v.school_name = s.school_name
  WHERE v.county IN (SELECT county FROM TopCounties)
),
MaxReadingByCounty AS (
  SELECT
    county,
    MAX(avg_reading_score) AS max_avg_reading_score
  FROM CountySchoolsWithScores
  GROUP BY county
),
Result AS (
  SELECT
    tc.county,
    tc.virtual_school_count,
    CASE WHEN MAX(s.avg_reading_score) IS NULL THEN 'None'
         ELSE s.school_name END AS top_school_name
  FROM TopCounties tc
  JOIN CountySchoolsWithScores s ON tc.county = s.county
  JOIN MaxReadingByCounty c ON s.county = c.county AND (s.avg_reading_score = c.max_avg_reading_score OR (c.max_avg_reading_score IS NULL AND s.avg_reading_score IS NULL))
  GROUP BY tc.county, tc.virtual_school_count, s.school_name
)
SELECT * FROM Result
ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC, county, top_school_name;

WITH school_of_interest AS (
  SELECT County FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = '1100170109835'
),
exclusive_virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode, [County Name] AS County FROM frpm WHERE [Educational Option Type] = 'F'
),
selected_counties AS (
  SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS County
  UNION
  SELECT County FROM school_of_interest
),
count_exclusive_virtual AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS exclusive_virtual_school_count
  FROM exclusive_virtual_schools
  WHERE County IN (SELECT County FROM selected_counties)
  GROUP BY County
)
SELECT County, exclusive_virtual_school_count
FROM count_exclusive_virtual
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_school_count DESC, County ASC;

WITH frpm_summary AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode AS cds,
        MAX([Enrollment (K-12)]) AS total_students,
        MAX([FRPM Count (K-12)]) AS frpm_eligible_count,
        MAX([Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)]) / 100.0 AS frpm_share
    FROM frpm
    GROUP BY CDSCode
),
schools_filtered AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode AS cds,
        s.School AS schoolname,
        s.County AS countyname,
        s.City AS city,
        s.MailStreet AS mailing_address_street,
        s.MailCity AS mailing_address_city,
        s.MailState AS mailing_address_state,
        s.MailZip AS mailing_address_zip,
        s.Website AS website,
        f.total_students AS k_12_enrollment,
        f.frpm_eligible_count,
        f.frpm_share,
        s.OpenDate AS opening_date,
        s.ClosedDate AS closing_date,
        CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm_summary f ON s.CDSCode = f.cds
    WHERE s.Charter = 0 AND f.total_students > 100
),
satscores_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS avg_total_sat_score,
        100.0 * SUM(NumGE1500) / SUM(NumTstTakr) AS pct_sat_1500plus
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
),
ranked_frpm AS (
    SELECT
        sf.*,
        ss.avg_total_sat_score,
        ss.pct_sat_1500plus
    FROM schools_filtered sf
    LEFT JOIN satscores_summary ss ON sf.cds = ss.cds
),
max_frpm AS (
    SELECT MAX(frpm_eligible_count) AS max_count FROM ranked_frpm
),
min_frpm_share AS (
    SELECT MIN(frpm_share) AS min_share FROM ranked_frpm
),
selected_schools AS (
    SELECT
        schoolname,
        countyname,
        city,
        mailing_address_street,
        mailing_address_city,
        mailing_address_state,
        mailing_address_zip,
        website,
        k_12_enrollment,
        frpm_eligible_count,
        frpm_share,
        avg_total_sat_score,
        pct_sat_1500plus,
        opening_date,
        status,
        'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS label
    FROM ranked_frpm, max_frpm
    WHERE frpm_eligible_count = max_count
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
        schoolname,
        countyname,
        city,
        mailing_address_street,
        mailing_address_city,
        mailing_address_state,
        mailing_address_zip,
        website,
        k_12_enrollment,
        frpm_eligible_count,
        frpm_share,
        avg_total_sat_score,
        pct_sat_1500plus,
        opening_date,
        status,
        'smallest FRPM share' AS label
    FROM ranked_frpm, min_frpm_share
    WHERE frpm_share = min_share
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
        schoolname,
        countyname,
        city,
        mailing_address_street,
        mailing_address_city,
        mailing_address_state,
        mailing_address_zip,
        website,
        k_12_enrollment,
        frpm_eligible_count,
        frpm_share,
        avg_total_sat_score,
        pct_sat_1500plus,
        opening_date,
        status,
        'the CDS code from my notes' AS label
    FROM ranked_frpm
    WHERE cds = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT * FROM selected_schools
ORDER BY
    CASE label
        WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
        WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
        WHEN 'the CDS code from my notes' THEN 3
    END,
    schoolname
;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30
AND (
  (CASE
    WHEN f.`High Grade` IN ('K', 'KG', 'Kindergarten') THEN 8
    WHEN cast(f.`High Grade` as integer) <= 8 THEN cast(f.`High Grade` as integer)
    ELSE 9
  END) <= 8
)

WITH EnrollmentData AS (
    SELECT 
        frpm.CDSCode,
        frpm.[School Name] AS SchoolName,
        schools.Street AS StreetAddress,
        CAST(frpm.[Low Grade] AS INTEGER) AS LowGrade,
        frpm.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS EnrollK12,
        frpm.[Enrollment (Ages 5-17)] AS Enroll517
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
    WHERE CAST(frpm.[Low Grade] AS INTEGER) >= 9
)
SELECT SchoolName, StreetAddress
FROM EnrollmentData
WHERE EnrollK12 - Enroll517 > 30
ORDER BY CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH SatData AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode AS school_code,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State,
    sats.NumTstTakr AS students_sat,
    sats.NumGE1500 AS excellent_count,
    CASE WHEN sats.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN sats.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sats.NumTstTakr ELSE 0 END AS excellence_rate
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sats ON s.CDSCode = sats.cds
  WHERE sats.NumTstTakr >= 700
)
SELECT Street, City, Zip, State
FROM SatData
ORDER BY excellence_rate ASC, school_code ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH provision2_base_schools AS (
    SELECT
        frpm.CDSCode
    FROM
        frpm
    WHERE
        frpm.[NSLP Provision Status] = 'Provision 2'
    GROUP BY
        frpm.CDSCode
    HAVING
        COUNT(DISTINCT frpm.[NSLP Provision Status]) = 1
),
magnet_provision2_schools AS (
    SELECT
        schools.City,
        schools.CDSCode
    FROM
        schools
    JOIN provision2_base_schools p2 ON schools.CDSCode = p2.CDSCode
    WHERE
        schools.Magnet = 1
)
SELECT
    City,
    COUNT(CDSCode) AS magnet_schools_provision_2
FROM
    magnet_provision2_schools
GROUP BY
    City
HAVING
    COUNT(CDSCode) > 0
ORDER BY
    magnet_schools_provision_2 DESC;

WITH PublicHighSchools AS (
  SELECT frpm."School Name" AS SchoolName,
         schools.Street AS StreetAddress,
         schools.City, schools.State, schools.Zip
  FROM frpm
  JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
  WHERE frpm."County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
    AND frpm."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 500
    AND (
      frpm."School Type" IN ('Regular High School', 'Continuation High School', 'High School in Single-School District')
    )
)
SELECT DISTINCT SchoolName, StreetAddress, City, State, Zip
FROM PublicHighSchools
ORDER BY SchoolName;

WITH no_power_cards AS (
    SELECT id, uuid
    FROM cards
    WHERE power IS NULL OR power LIKE '%*%'
), triggered_rulings_uuids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT uuid
    FROM rulings
    WHERE LOWER(text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT npc.id) AS count_distinct_card_printings
FROM no_power_cards npc
JOIN triggered_rulings_uuids tru ON npc.uuid = tru.uuid;

WITH cards_power_info AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    power,
    CASE WHEN power LIKE '%*%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_variable_power
  FROM cards
),
cards_no_power_variable AS (
  SELECT distinct cpi.id, cpi.power, cpi.has_variable_power
  FROM cards_power_info cpi
  WHERE (cpi.power IS NULL OR cpi.power = '') OR cpi.has_variable_power = 1
),
cards_with_french_translation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.id
  FROM cards c
  JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode
  WHERE st.language = 'French'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT cwt.id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT cnpv.id),
  2
) AS pct_with_french_translation
FROM cards_no_power_variable cnpv
LEFT JOIN cards_with_french_translation cwt ON cnpv.id = cwt.id;

WITH PromoCreatures AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.isPromo = 1 AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
),
BrawlCommanders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.uuid
  FROM legalities l
  WHERE l.format = 'brawl' AND l.status = 'legal'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM PromoCreatures pc
JOIN BrawlCommanders bc ON pc.uuid = bc.uuid;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf' AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
), frame_version_years AS (
    -- Extract year from semantic layer info for frameVersion
    SELECT frameVersion,
    CASE
        WHEN frameVersion LIKE '1997%' THEN 1997
        WHEN frameVersion LIKE '2003%' THEN 2003
        WHEN frameVersion LIKE '2015%' THEN 2015
        WHEN frameVersion LIKE '2019%' THEN 2019
        ELSE NULL
    END AS year
    FROM tarmogoyf_printings
)
SELECT MAX(year) - MIN(year) AS year_span
FROM frame_version_years
WHERE year IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_black_border_10_or_greater
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
AND power IS NOT NULL
AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
AND isOnlineOnly = 1;

WITH unique_translations AS (
    SELECT setCode, LOWER(translation) AS translation
    FROM set_translations
    GROUP BY setCode, LOWER(translation)
),
translation_counts AS (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS translation_count
    FROM unique_translations
    GROUP BY setCode
),
sets_fewer_than_five AS (
    SELECT setCode
    FROM translation_counts
    WHERE translation_count < 5
)
SELECT SUM(card_count) AS total_cards
FROM (
    SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE setCode IN (SELECT setCode FROM sets_fewer_than_five)
    GROUP BY setCode
)

WITH SetsWithOfficialTranslation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.type
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE st.translatioN IS NOT NULL AND st.translatioN != ''
), 
SetsWithTranslationCount AS (
  SELECT s.type, COUNT(DISTINCT s.code) AS sets_with_translation_count
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE st.translatioN IS NOT NULL AND st.translatioN != ''
  GROUP BY s.type
),
CardCountsByType AS (
  SELECT s.type, COUNT(c.id) AS card_count
  FROM sets s
  LEFT JOIN cards c ON s.code = c.setCode
  GROUP BY s.type
)

SELECT 
  s1.type AS set_type,
  COALESCE(swt.sets_with_translation_count, 0) AS sets_with_translation_count,
  COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets) s1
  LEFT JOIN SetsWithTranslationCount swt ON s1.type = swt.type
  LEFT JOIN CardCountsByType cc ON s1.type = cc.type

WITH CreatureCards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id, artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE instr(types, 'Creature') > 0
),
ArtistCardCounts AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(id) AS creature_card_count
    FROM CreatureCards
    GROUP BY artist
),
MaxCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(creature_card_count) AS max_count
    FROM ArtistCardCounts
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM ArtistCardCounts
WHERE creature_card_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxCount);

WITH zero_cost_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT frameVersion AS frame_version
  FROM cards
  WHERE convertedManaCost = 0 AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
), max_frame AS (
  SELECT MAX(frame_version) AS max_frame_version
  FROM zero_cost_cards
), newest_frame_versions AS (
  SELECT frame_version
  FROM zero_cost_cards
  WHERE frame_version = (SELECT max_frame_version FROM max_frame)
), frame_counts AS (
  SELECT frameVersion AS frame_version, COUNT(*) AS count_cards
  FROM cards
  WHERE frameVersion IN (SELECT frame_version FROM newest_frame_versions)
  GROUP BY frameVersion
)
SELECT frame_version, count_cards
FROM frame_counts
ORDER BY frame_version DESC;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM cards
    WHERE lower(name) = 'tarmogoyf'
), frame_counts AS (
    SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS frame_count
    FROM tarmogoyf_printings
    GROUP BY frameVersion
), total_printings AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM tarmogoyf_printings
), newest_frame AS (
    SELECT frameVersion
    FROM frame_counts
    ORDER BY frameVersion DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    f.frameVersion AS latest_frame_version,
    ROUND(CAST(f.frame_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count * 100, 2) AS percentage_of_total_printings
FROM frame_counts f
CROSS JOIN total_printings t
JOIN newest_frame n ON n.frameVersion = f.frameVersion

WITH CommanderLegalCards AS (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM legalities
  WHERE format = 'Commander' AND status = 'Legal'
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS zero_cost_commander_legal_cards
FROM cards c
JOIN CommanderLegalCards clc ON c.uuid = clc.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count_with_flying_and_cycling
FROM cards
WHERE text LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND text LIKE '%Cycling%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS release_promotion_card_count
FROM cards
WHERE promoTypes LIKE '%release%'
  AND promoTypes NOT LIKE '%prerelease%'
;

WITH abzan_cards AS (
  SELECT
    cards.uuid,
    cards.name,
    cards.number,
    cards.setCode
  FROM cards
  WHERE cards.watermark = 'abzan'
), max_collector_number AS (
  SELECT
    setCode,
    MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER)) AS max_collector_number
  FROM abzan_cards
  GROUP BY setCode
), max_abzan_cards AS (
  SELECT
    abzan_cards.uuid,
    abzan_cards.name,
    CAST(abzan_cards.number AS INTEGER) AS collector_number,
    abzan_cards.setCode
  FROM abzan_cards
  JOIN max_collector_number ON abzan_cards.setCode = max_collector_number.setCode
    AND CAST(abzan_cards.number AS INTEGER) = max_collector_number.max_collector_number
), foreign_printings_count AS (
  SELECT
    foreign_data.uuid AS card_uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS foreign_printings
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY foreign_data.uuid
)
SELECT
  max_abzan_cards.name,
  max_abzan_cards.collector_number,
  IFNULL(foreign_printings_count.foreign_printings, 0) AS foreign_printings
FROM max_abzan_cards
LEFT JOIN foreign_printings_count ON max_abzan_cards.uuid = foreign_printings_count.card_uuid
ORDER BY max_abzan_cards.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS white_bordered_power_less_than_3_count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power != '*'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) < 3;

WITH flash_cards AS (
  SELECT name, convertedManaCost
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode = (SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Dark Ascension')
    AND keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
), max_cmc AS (
  SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) AS max_cmc FROM flash_cards
)
SELECT name
FROM flash_cards, max_cmc
WHERE convertedManaCost = max_cmc
ORDER BY name ASC;

WITH sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT code, name, keyruneCode
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
), translation_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT language) AS language_count
  FROM set_translations
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT s.name, s.keyruneCode, COALESCE(t.language_count, 0) AS language_count
FROM sets_2020 s
LEFT JOIN translation_counts t ON s.code = t.setCode
ORDER BY s.name

WITH localized_sets_2017 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
    AND st.language != 'English'
), cards_in_localized_sets AS (
  SELECT c.id
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM localized_sets_2017)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards_in_localized_sets;

WITH black_border_power_10_plus AS (
    SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards
    WHERE borderColor = 'black'
      AND mtgArenaId IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    GROUP BY artist
), max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(card_count) AS max_card_count
    FROM black_border_power_10_plus
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM black_border_power_10_plus
WHERE card_count = (SELECT max_card_count FROM max_count);

WITH flagged_paper_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid
  FROM cards c
  JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
  WHERE c.hasContentWarning = 1
    AND l.format = 'paper'
    AND l.status = 'legal'
),
mtgo_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid
  FROM legalities
  WHERE format = 'mtgo'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_flagged_paper_not_mtgo
FROM flagged_paper_cards fp
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM mtgo_cards m
  WHERE m.uuid = fp.uuid
)

WITH japanese_name_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'Japanese'
),
expansion_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets
)
SELECT 
  et.type AS expansion_type,
  COUNT(jns.setCode) AS japanese_name_count
FROM expansion_types et
LEFT JOIN sets s ON et.type = s.type
LEFT JOIN japanese_name_sets jns ON s.code = jns.setCode
GROUP BY et.type
ORDER BY et.type ASC;

WITH arena_only_big_artists AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE borderColor = 'black'
    AND power GLOB '[0-9]+'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS num_artists
FROM arena_only_big_artists;

WITH latest_sets AS (
  SELECT setCode, MAX(originalReleaseDate) AS latest_release
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = "Ancestor's Chosen"
  GROUP BY setCode
), max_release AS (
  SELECT MAX(latest_release) AS max_release_date
  FROM latest_sets
), latest_sets_group AS (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM latest_sets
  WHERE latest_release = (SELECT max_release_date FROM max_release)
)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards c
JOIN latest_sets_group lsg ON c.setCode = lsg.setCode
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INT) > CAST(c.toughness AS INT);

WITH FoilCards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasFoil = 1
),
RegularCards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasNonFoil = 1
),
BothPrintingsCards AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM FoilCards
  INTERSECT
  SELECT name
  FROM RegularCards
),
CommanderLeadableCards AS (
  SELECT name, frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE name IN (SELECT name FROM BothPrintingsCards) AND leadershipSkills IS NOT NULL AND leadershipSkills != ''
),
FrameYears AS (
  SELECT name, 
    CASE
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%1997%' THEN 1997
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%2003%' THEN 2003
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%2015%' THEN 2015
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%2016%' THEN 2016
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%2019%' THEN 2019
      WHEN frameVersion LIKE '%2021%' THEN 2021
      ELSE NULL
    END AS frame_year
  FROM CommanderLeadableCards
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
),
MaxFrameYear AS (
  SELECT MAX(frame_year) AS max_year
  FROM FrameYears
  WHERE frame_year IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT max_year AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM FrameYears, MaxFrameYear
WHERE frame_year = max_year
GROUP BY frame_year
LIMIT 1;

WITH fireball_cards AS (
  SELECT uuid
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Fireball'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rulings
FROM rulings
WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM fireball_cards);

WITH elf_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT scryfallOracleId, name
  FROM cards
  WHERE originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
),
rulings_with_oracle AS (
  SELECT r.id, c.scryfallOracleId
  FROM rulings r
  JOIN cards c ON r.uuid = c.uuid
),
rulings_counts AS (
  SELECT scryfallOracleId, COUNT(id) AS cnt
  FROM rulings_with_oracle
  GROUP BY scryfallOracleId
),
card_ruling_counts AS (
  SELECT ec.name, COALESCE(rc.cnt, 0) AS rulings_count
  FROM elf_cards ec
  LEFT JOIN rulings_counts rc ON ec.scryfallOracleId = rc.scryfallOracleId
),
max_rulings AS (
  SELECT MAX(rulings_count) AS max_count FROM card_ruling_counts
)
SELECT crc.name, crc.rulings_count
FROM card_ruling_counts crc, max_rulings
WHERE crc.rulings_count = max_rulings.max_count;

WITH color_legalities AS (
    SELECT
        c.colors AS card_color,
        l.format
    FROM cards c
    JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
    WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
      AND l.status = 'Legal'
      AND (c.colors = 'W' OR c.colors = 'B')
), color_format_counts AS (
    SELECT
        card_color,
        COUNT(DISTINCT format) AS legal_format_count
    FROM color_legalities
    GROUP BY card_color
)
SELECT card_color, legal_format_count
FROM color_format_counts
ORDER BY card_color;

WITH AvonPowerfulFoil AS (
    SELECT c.frameVersion
    FROM cards c
    WHERE c.artist = 'John Avon'
      AND c.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
      AND c.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
), MaxFrameVersion AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_version
    FROM AvonPowerfulFoil
)
SELECT a.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM AvonPowerfulFoil a
JOIN MaxFrameVersion m ON a.frameVersion = m.max_version
GROUP BY a.frameVersion
ORDER BY a.frameVersion DESC;

WITH erica_yang_cards AS (
  SELECT c.uuid
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.artist = 'Erica Yang'
),
paper_printings AS (
  SELECT fd.uuid
  FROM foreign_data fd
  WHERE fd.language = 'English'
),
pauper_legalities AS (
  SELECT l.uuid
  FROM legalities l
  WHERE l.format = 'pauper' AND l.status = 'Legal'
),
valid_printings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eyc.uuid
  FROM erica_yang_cards eyc
  JOIN paper_printings pp ON eyc.uuid = pp.uuid
  JOIN pauper_legalities pl ON eyc.uuid = pl.uuid
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM valid_printings;

WITH foil_and_nonfoil AS (
  SELECT c1.name, c1.cardKingdomFoilId, c2.cardKingdomId
  FROM cards c1
  INNER JOIN cards c2 ON c1.name = c2.name
  WHERE c1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND c1.cardKingdomFoilId != ''
    AND c2.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND c2.cardKingdomId != ''
    AND c1.types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND c2.types LIKE '%Creature%'
)
SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM foil_and_nonfoil
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId ASC, cardKingdomId ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH ravnica_guilds AS (
    SELECT 'Azorius' AS guild, 'azorius' AS watermark UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Boros', 'boros' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Dimir', 'dimir' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Golgari', 'golgari' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Gruul', 'gruul' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Izzet', 'izzet' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Orzhov', 'orzhov' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Rakdos', 'rakdos' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Selesnya', 'selesnya' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Simic', 'simic'
), cards_with_ravnica_guild AS (
    SELECT c.name, c.watermark
    FROM cards c
    INNER JOIN ravnica_guilds r ON LOWER(c.watermark) = r.watermark
), cards_printed_other_lang AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.name
    FROM foreign_data f
    WHERE f.language != 'English'
), ravnica_cards_printed_other_lang AS (
    SELECT c.watermark, r.guild
    FROM cards_with_ravnica_guild c
    JOIN ravnica_guilds r ON LOWER(c.watermark) = r.watermark
    JOIN cards_printed_other_lang copl ON copl.name = c.name
)
SELECT r.guild, COUNT(*) AS cards_in_other_lang
FROM ravnica_cards_printed_other_lang r
GROUP BY r.guild
HAVING cards_in_other_lang = (
    SELECT MAX(count_per_guild)
    FROM (
        SELECT r2.guild, COUNT(*) AS count_per_guild
        FROM ravnica_cards_printed_other_lang r2
        GROUP BY r2.guild
    )
)
ORDER BY r.guild
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE isTextless = 0
  AND CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 2015;

WITH LatestFrame AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_frame
    FROM cards
),
PromoMultiFaceCards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name
    FROM cards
    WHERE isPromo = 1
      AND layout IN ('double-faced', 'modal_dfc', 'transform')
      AND frameVersion = (SELECT max_frame FROM LatestFrame)
)
SELECT name
FROM PromoMultiFaceCards
ORDER BY name;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate, c.frameVersion 
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
frame_years AS (
  SELECT set_name, releaseDate, CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_reprints AS (
  SELECT set_name, releaseDate
  FROM frame_years
  WHERE (CAST(strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS INTEGER) - frame_year) >= 10
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_name, releaseDate
FROM qualifying_reprints
ORDER BY releaseDate;

WITH target_type AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
),
sets_same_type AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
  FROM sets s
  JOIN target_type tt ON s.type = tt.type
),
sets_foreign_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation != ''
)
SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets_same_type s
LEFT JOIN sets_foreign_names f ON s.code = f.setCode
WHERE f.setCode IS NULL
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

WITH FilteredCards AS (
    SELECT c.setCode, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate, c.frameVersion
    FROM cards c
    JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
), 
MaxFrame AS (
    SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_frame
    FROM FilteredCards
), 
MaxFramePrintings AS (
    SELECT setCode, set_name, releaseDate, frameVersion
    FROM FilteredCards
    WHERE frameVersion = (SELECT max_frame FROM MaxFrame)
), 
MaxReleaseDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(releaseDate) AS max_release_date
    FROM MaxFramePrintings
),
FinalCandidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT set_name, releaseDate
    FROM MaxFramePrintings
    WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT max_release_date FROM MaxReleaseDate)
)
SELECT set_name, releaseDate
FROM FinalCandidates
ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, set_name ASC;

WITH sets_2020 AS (
    SELECT code, release_date
    FROM sets
    WHERE release_date >= '2020-01-01' AND release_date < '2021-01-01'
),
spanish_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT set_code
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE language = 'Spanish'
)
SELECT s.code, s.release_date
FROM sets_2020 s
LEFT JOIN spanish_sets ss ON s.code = ss.set_code
WHERE ss.set_code IS NULL
ORDER BY s.release_date;
SELECT 0 AS total_converted_mana_cost;

WITH Sets2016 AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate >= '2016-01-01' AND releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
),
TranslationsCount AS (
  SELECT s.code, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS lang_count
  FROM Sets2016 s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(lang_count), 2) AS avg_languages
FROM TranslationsCount;

WITH FlavorTranslationsByLang AS (
  SELECT st.language, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS num_flavor_translated_printings
  FROM cards c
  JOIN set_translations st ON c.setCode = st.setCode AND c.flavorText IS NOT NULL AND c.flavorText <> ''
  GROUP BY st.language
),
MinFlavorTranslations AS (
  SELECT MIN(num_flavor_translated_printings) AS min_translations
  FROM FlavorTranslationsByLang
)
SELECT language, num_flavor_translated_printings
FROM FlavorTranslationsByLang
WHERE num_flavor_translated_printings = (SELECT min_translations FROM MinFlavorTranslations)
ORDER BY language ASC;

WITH french_set_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'French'
),
power_10_or_more_creatures AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
),
cards_with_french_printings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT setCode FROM french_set_codes)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.name) AS count_creature_cards
FROM power_10_or_more_creatures p
JOIN cards_with_french_printings c ON p.name = c.name;

WITH mtgo_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE mtgoCode IS NOT NULL AND mtgoCode != ''
), printings_2014 AS (
  SELECT * 
  FROM cards
  WHERE originalReleaseDate >= '2014-01-01' AND originalReleaseDate < '2015-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM printings_2014 p
JOIN mtgo_sets s ON p.setCode = s.code;

WITH OfficialLanguages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM foreign_data
  WHERE language IN (
    SELECT language
    FROM sets
    WHERE language IS NOT NULL
  )
),
PrintingsCount AS (
  SELECT f.language, COUNT(f.uuid) AS printings
  FROM foreign_data f
  JOIN OfficialLanguages o ON f.language = o.language
  GROUP BY f.language
),
MinPrintings AS (
  SELECT MIN(printings) AS min_printings
  FROM PrintingsCount
)
SELECT language, printings
FROM PrintingsCount
WHERE printings = (SELECT min_printings FROM MinPrintings)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS italian_rules_printings_count
FROM cards
WHERE setCode = 'CSP' AND text IS NOT NULL AND text != ''

WITH Commander_sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT id, code, name
  FROM sets
  WHERE type = 'Commander' AND releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
),
Cards_counted AS (
  SELECT s.id AS set_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS card_count
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.type = 'Commander'
    AND s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
    AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
  GROUP BY s.id
),
Promo_card_counts AS (
  SELECT ps.parentCode AS parent_code, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS promo_card_count
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets ps ON c.setCode = ps.code
  WHERE ps.parentCode IS NOT NULL
    AND ps.parentCode IN (SELECT code FROM Commander_sets_2020)
    AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
  GROUP BY ps.parentCode
),
Total_card_counts AS (
  SELECT cs.id, cs.name, cs.code,
    (COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) + COALESCE(pc.promo_card_count, 0)) AS total_cards
  FROM Commander_sets_2020 cs
  LEFT JOIN Cards_counted cc ON cc.set_id = cs.id
  LEFT JOIN Promo_card_counts pc ON pc.parent_code = cs.code
),
Languages AS (
  SELECT fd.language, s.id AS set_id
  FROM foreign_data fd
  JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE s.type = 'Commander' AND s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
)

SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.language) AS num_languages
FROM Total_card_counts t
LEFT JOIN Languages la ON t.id = la.set_id
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.total_cards
HAVING t.total_cards = (SELECT MAX(total_cards) FROM Total_card_counts)
ORDER BY t.id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT foreign_data.language) AS num_languages
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.multiverseid = cards.multiverseId
WHERE cards.name = 'Swamp';

WITH MonoBlackArtifacts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT name
    FROM cards
    WHERE colors = 'B'
      AND types LIKE '%Artifact%'
),
FlavorLanguages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.name
    FROM set_translations st
    JOIN cards c ON st.id = c.id
    WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND LENGTH(TRIM(st.translation)) > 0
      AND st.language != 'English'
),
EligibleCards AS (
    SELECT mba.name
    FROM MonoBlackArtifacts mba
    JOIN FlavorLanguages fl ON mba.name = fl.name
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS num_mono_black_artifact_cards_with_foreign_flavor
FROM EligibleCards;

WITH CommentersWithLinks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.userId
  FROM comments c
  WHERE c.text LIKE '%http://%'
), UserAges AS (
  SELECT u.id, (julianday('now') - julianday(u.creationDate))/365.25 AS age
  FROM users u
  JOIN CommentersWithLinks cl ON u.id = cl.userId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 2) AS avg_age_of_link_commenters
FROM UserAges;

WITH OrganizerBadge AS (
  SELECT userId, MIN(date) AS OrganizerDate
  FROM badges
  WHERE name = 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY userId
),
GermanyOrganizerUsers AS (
  SELECT u.Id AS userId, ob.OrganizerDate
  FROM users u
  JOIN OrganizerBadge ob ON u.Id = ob.userId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
EarlierBadgesCount AS (
  SELECT b.userId, COUNT(*) AS badge_count_before_Organizer
  FROM badges b
  JOIN GermanyOrganizerUsers gou ON b.userId = gou.userId
  JOIN OrganizerBadge ob ON b.userId = ob.userId
  WHERE b.date < ob.OrganizerDate
    AND b.name != 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY b.userId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_with_5_badges_before_Organizer
FROM EarlierBadgesCount
WHERE badge_count_before_Organizer >= 5;

WITH FirstPosts AS (
    SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS firstPostDate
    FROM posts
    WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
), UsersFirstPost2010 AS (
    SELECT u.Id
    FROM users u
    JOIN FirstPosts fp ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
    WHERE strftime('%Y', fp.firstPostDate) = '2010'
      AND u.Location = 'India'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_users_in_india_first_post_2010
FROM UsersFirstPost2010;

WITH R_Posts AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerUserId
  FROM posts p
  WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tags t
    JOIN postLinks pl ON pl.PostId = p.Id
    WHERE t.TagName = 'r'
    LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS AvgReputation
FROM users u
JOIN R_Posts r ON u.Id = r.OwnerUserId;

WITH Posts2012 AS (
  SELECT Id, Score, LastEditorUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2012'
),
GermanyUsers AS (
  SELECT Id, Reputation
  FROM users
  WHERE location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
GermanyLastEditorPosts AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.Score, p.LastEditorUserId
  FROM Posts2012 p
  JOIN GermanyUsers g ON p.LastEditorUserId = g.Id
),

GermanyLastEditorUserSummary AS (

WITH TargetQuestion AS (

QuestionsWithTagR AS (

WITH CaliforniaUsers AS (

WITH yearling_users AS (

WITH SupporterBadgeUsers AS (

AdultSupporters AS (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DisplayName) AS DistinctDisplayNames

WITH TargetPosts AS (

),
RelatedCounts AS (

MaxRelatedCount AS (

WITH bounty_users AS (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT userId) AS bounty_users_count

WITH posts_2012 AS (

upvotes_cast AS (

WITH PostAnswerCounts AS (

LinkCountsByMonth AS (

AllMonths AS (

  SELECT '2010-05' UNION ALL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(lc.posts_with_links, 0)), 2) AS average_posts

WITH posts_2010 AS (

), high_rep_users AS (

),
count_total AS (

),
count_not_high_rep AS (

SELECT

WITH PostEdits AS (

SELECT u.displayName, te.total_edit_comments
FROM TopEditors te
JOIN users u ON te.userId = u.id;

WITH consumption_2012 AS (

    SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_consumption_2012
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01' AND Date <= '2012-12-31'

),
filtered_customers AS (

SELECT Segment AS client_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS number_of_customers

WITH consumption_2013 AS (

)

WITH czech_high_value_transactions AS (

  JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
  WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Price > 1000
)
SELECT CAST((strftime('%s', last_transaction) - strftime('%s', first_transaction)) / 60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_minutes

WITH yearly_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_consumption_2012
  FROM
    customers c
  JOIN
    transactions_1k t
  ON
    c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
  WHERE
    strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY
    c.CustomerID, c.Currency
),
avg_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    Currency,
    AVG(total_consumption_2012) AS avg_consumption
  FROM
    yearly_consumption
  WHERE
    total_consumption_2012 > 0
    AND Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  GROUP BY
    Currency
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption ELSE NULL END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption ELSE NULL END)
  ) AS difference
FROM
  avg_consumption;

WITH kam_czk_customers AS (

), yearly_consumption AS (

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT k.CustomerID) AS kam_czk_heavy_customers

WITH february_gas_purchase AS (

WITH young_defensive AS (

WITH LatestPlayerAttributes AS (

FilteredPlayers AS (

WITH RiskyTeams AS (

),
FilteredTeams AS (

TeamsOnDate AS (

NameCounts AS (

FinalData AS (

WITH LatestDefensiveWork AS (

JOIN MediumDefensivePlayers m ON p.player_api_id = m.player_api_id;

WITH LatestAttributes AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, preferred_foot

    WHERE (player_api_id, date) IN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date)
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS avg_weight_left_footed

JOIN LatestAttributes la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id

WITH HomeWins AS (
  SELECT
    m.match_api_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal AS goal_diff
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),

RecentSpeed AS (
  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.date AS speed_date,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
),

HomeWinsWithSpeed AS (
  SELECT
    hw.match_api_id,
    hw.team_id,
    hw.match_date,
    rs.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hw.match_api_id, hw.team_id ORDER BY rs.speed_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM HomeWins hw
  LEFT JOIN RecentSpeed rs
    ON hw.team_id = rs.team_api_id
    AND rs.speed_date <= hw.match_date
),

FilteredWins AS (
  SELECT match_api_id, team_id
  FROM HomeWinsWithSpeed
  WHERE rn = 1
),

ClubWins AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_api_id,
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM FilteredWins fw
  JOIN Team t ON fw.team_id = t.team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
),

MaxWins AS (

)

SELECT cw.club_name, cw.team_short_name, cw.wins
FROM ClubWins cw, MaxWins
WHERE cw.wins = MaxWins.max_wins
ORDER BY cw.club_name
LIMIT 1000

WITH LatestRatings AS (

  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
LatestRatingRecords AS (

  JOIN LatestRatings lr ON pa.player_api_id = lr.player_api_id AND pa.date = lr.max_date
),
FilteredRatingRecords AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count

WITH ThirdPlayers AS (

PlayerMatchGoals AS (

  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match UNION ALL

  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match UNION ALL
  SELECT id, country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
PlayerWeights AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(weight) AS weight
  FROM Player
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
FilteredPlayers AS (
  SELECT pl.match_id, pl.country_id, pl.player_api_id

PlayerCountByCountryMatch AS (

MinPlayersCountryMatch AS (

GlobalMinCount AS (

),
CountriesWithFewestPlayers AS (
  SELECT country_id
  FROM MinPlayersCountryMatch, GlobalMinCount
  WHERE min_player_count = global_min_players
)
SELECT c.name AS country_name
FROM CountriesWithFewestPlayers f
JOIN Country c ON f.country_id = c.id
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS count_preferred_left_foot_and_low_or_medium_attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percent_low_attacking_work_rate
FROM LatestAttributes

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS high_jumping_score_players
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2007-08-30'

WITH last_match AS (
    SELECT M.id, M.date
    FROM Match M
    JOIN Team T ON (M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id OR M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id)
    WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
      AND M.season = '2012/2013'
    ORDER BY M.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
), 
team_attr_at_last_match AS (
    SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
    FROM Team_Attributes TA
    JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
    JOIN last_match LM ON TA.date <= LM.date
    WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
    ORDER BY TA.date DESC
    LIMIT 1

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
