WITH RankedRatings AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_name,
    pa.date,
    pa.overall_rating,
    pa.defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_name ORDER BY ABS(julianday(pa.date) - julianday('2013-07-12'))) AS rn
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),

-- Pick the closest rating by date for each player to 2013-07-12
ClosestRatings AS (
  SELECT player_name, overall_rating
  FROM RankedRatings
  WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Get Landon Donovan's closest rating
DonovanRating AS (
  SELECT overall_rating
  FROM ClosestRatings
  WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
),

-- Average overall rating on that date among all players
AvgRating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) as avg_overall_rating
  FROM ClosestRatings
)

SELECT ROUND((DonovanRating.overall_rating - AvgRating.avg_overall_rating) * 100.0 / AvgRating.avg_overall_rating, 2) AS percentage_higher
FROM DonovanRating, AvgRating;

WITH RunningLoansDistricts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'D'
),
UnemploymentRates AS (
  SELECT A8 AS district_id, A14 AS year, A10 AS unemployment_rate
  FROM district
  WHERE A14 IN (1995, 1996)
)
SELECT u1995.district_id, 
       u1995.unemployment_rate AS unemployment_1995, 
       u1996.unemployment_rate AS unemployment_1996,
       ROUND((u1996.unemployment_rate - u1995.unemployment_rate) * 100.0 / u1995.unemployment_rate, 2) AS pct_change
FROM UnemploymentRates u1995
JOIN UnemploymentRates u1996 ON u1995.district_id = u1996.district_id AND u1996.year = 1996
WHERE u1995.year = 1995
  AND u1995.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM RunningLoansDistricts)
ORDER BY u1995.district_id;

WITH first_month_account AS (
  SELECT MIN(date) AS first_date FROM account
), first_month AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', first_date) AS first_month_str FROM first_month_account
), accounts_in_first_month_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN first_month f ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.first_month_str
), max_population AS (
  SELECT MAX(A8) AS max_pop
  FROM district d
  JOIN accounts_in_first_month_districts afmd ON afmd.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT d.district_id, d.A8 AS population
FROM district d
JOIN accounts_in_first_month_districts afmd ON afmd.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN max_population mp ON d.A8 = mp.max_pop

WITH north_bohemia_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
),
accounts_as_of_1995 AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, d.client_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE a.date <= '1995-12-31'
),
north_bohemia_accounts AS (
  SELECT ac.account_id, ac.client_id
  FROM accounts_as_of_1995 ac
  JOIN north_bohemia_clients nb ON ac.client_id = nb.client_id
),
clients_with_ab_trans AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nb.client_id
  FROM north_bohemia_accounts nb
  JOIN trans t ON nb.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.bank = 'AB'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM clients_with_ab_trans;

WITH CentralBohemiaOwners AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id, a.account_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.district_id = 7  -- Central Bohemia district_id is 7 based on reference
      AND d.type = 'OWNER'
),
AccountsWithCards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card
    JOIN disp d ON card.disp_id = d.disp_id
),
OwnersWithoutCards AS (
    SELECT cbo.client_id, cbo.district_id
    FROM CentralBohemiaOwners cbo
    WHERE cbo.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM AccountsWithCards)
),
DistrictSalaries AS (
    SELECT district_id, AVG(A10) AS avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY district_id
),
SelectedDistrictSalaries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ds.avg_salary
    FROM OwnersWithoutCards owc
    JOIN DistrictSalaries ds ON owc.district_id = ds.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM SelectedDistrictSalaries;

WITH OwnerAccounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
),
LoanCounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
AccountLoanCounts AS (
    SELECT oa.account_id, COALESCE(lc.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count
    FROM OwnerAccounts oa
    LEFT JOIN LoanCounts lc ON oa.account_id = lc.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loan_count), 2) AS avg_loans_per_account
FROM AccountLoanCounts;

WITH male_customers AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
      AND strftime('%Y', birth_date) BETWEEN '1974' AND '1976'
),
accounts_of_male_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN male_customers mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
payments_over_4000 AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.type, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_of_male_clients)
      AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
      AND t.amount > 4000
),
categorized_payments AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(TRIM(k_symbol)) = 'household payment' THEN 1
            WHEN k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(k_symbol)) != 'household payment' THEN 0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS is_household_payment
    FROM payments_over_4000
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_household_payment = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS household_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_household_payment = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM categorized_payments
WHERE is_household_payment IS NOT NULL;

WITH pisek_district AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Pisek' OR A3 = 'Pisek' OR A4 = 'Pisek' OR A5 = 'Pisek' OR A6 = 'Pisek' OR A7 = 'Pisek'
  LIMIT 1
), pisek_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM account
  WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM pisek_district)
), outgoing_transactions AS (
  SELECT trans_id, type, amount, k_symbol
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM pisek_accounts)
    AND type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND k_symbol IS NOT NULL
), sipo_transactions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM outgoing_transactions
  WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO'
), totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM outgoing_transactions) AS total_outgoing,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM sipo_transactions) AS total_sipo
)
SELECT ROUND((total_sipo * 100.0) / total_outgoing, 2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM totals;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
    SELECT A2 AS region
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 IN (
        SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = (
            SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = (
                SELECT client_id FROM disp WHERE account_id IN (
                    SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
                ) LIMIT 1
            ) LIMIT 1
        )
    ) LIMIT 1
), district_codes_region AS (
    SELECT district_id, A2 AS region, A3 AS district_name
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
accounts_1996 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date, c.district_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp disp_l ON a.account_id = disp_l.account_id
    JOIN client c ON disp_l.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996'
),
last_trans_1996 AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date, t.trans_id, t.amount, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN accounts_1996 a96 ON t.account_id = a96.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
max_trans AS (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM last_trans_1996
    GROUP BY account_id
),
final_trans AS (
    SELECT lt.account_id, lt.balance
    FROM last_trans_1996 lt
    JOIN max_trans mt ON lt.account_id = mt.account_id AND lt.date = mt.max_date
    WHERE lt.trans_id = (
        SELECT MAX(trans_id)
        FROM last_trans_1996
        WHERE account_id = lt.account_id AND date = mt.max_date
    )
),
accounts_with_balance AS (
    SELECT a96.account_id, a96.district_id, ft.balance
    FROM accounts_1996 a96
    JOIN final_trans ft ON a96.account_id = ft.account_id
    WHERE a96.district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM district_codes_region)
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT dcr.district_name, 
           COUNT(DISTINCT awb.account_id) AS num_accounts,
           ROUND(AVG(awb.balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM accounts_with_balance awb
    JOIN district_codes_region dcr ON awb.district_id = dcr.district_id
    GROUP BY dcr.district_name
    HAVING num_accounts > 0
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM accounts_with_balance
),
top_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    WHERE avg_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_balance) FROM district_stats)
    ORDER BY district_name
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ds.district_name, ds.num_accounts, ds.avg_balance,
       (SELECT region_avg_balance FROM region_stats) AS region_avg_balance,
       (SELECT district_name FROM top_district) AS top_district
FROM district_stats ds
ORDER BY ds.district_name
LIMIT 1000;

WITH credited_interest_code AS (
    SELECT 'UROK' AS code
),
account_of_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account.account_id
    FROM account
    JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    WHERE disp.client_id = 2823
),
interest_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t.amount * CASE
            WHEN t.k_symbol = (SELECT code FROM credited_interest_code) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS credited_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_of_client)
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31'
      AND t.k_symbol = (SELECT code FROM credited_interest_code)
),
penalty_trans AS (
    SELECT
        t.amount AS penalty_amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_of_client)
      AND t.date >= '1998-01-01' AND t.date <= '1998-12-31'
      AND t.k_symbol = (SELECT bank FROM trans WHERE k_symbol = 'UROK' LIMIT 1) -- assuming sanction interest code is bank code from credited interest
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(credited_amount), 0) FROM interest_trans) - (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(penalty_amount), 0) FROM penalty_trans) AS net_interest_czk
;

WITH FemaleOlderClients AS (
  SELECT c.client_id
  FROM client c
  WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
),
AccountsOfTargetClients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN FemaleOlderClients foc ON d.client_id = foc.client_id
  JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A13), 2) AS avg_salary_of_districts
FROM district d
JOIN AccountsOfTargetClients aot ON aot.district_id = d.district_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(A10), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salaries
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < '1950-01-01'
);

WITH small_healthy_loans AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE amount < 100000
    AND status = 'C'
), loan_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.district_id
  FROM small_healthy_loans shl
  JOIN disp dis ON dis.account_id = shl.account_id
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dis.client_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(A10), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM loan_districts)

WITH newer_2017_races AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.raceId NOT IN (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2000)
), pit_stop_counts AS (
  SELECT ps.raceId, COUNT(*) AS pit_stops
  FROM pitStops ps
  JOIN newer_2017_races n17r ON ps.raceId = n17r.raceId
  GROUP BY ps.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stops), 2) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race
FROM pit_stop_counts;

WITH GermanDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob AS date_of_birth, url
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
), Q3Counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(Q3) AS q3_count
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE Q3 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT gd.forename, gd.surname, gd.url AS wikipedia_page, gd.date_of_birth, COALESCE(q3.q3_count, 0) AS q3_times
FROM GermanDrivers gd
LEFT JOIN Q3Counts q3 ON gd.driverId = q3.driverId
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, gd.date_of_birth ASC;

WITH japanese_gp_1995 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
  WHERE s.year = 1995 AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  LIMIT 1
), slowest_time AS (
  SELECT q.q1
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN japanese_gp_1995 j ON q.raceId = j.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(q.q1, ':', '') AS FLOAT) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.code as driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob as birthday, q.q1
FROM qualifying q
JOIN japanese_gp_1995 j ON q.raceId = j.raceId
JOIN slowest_time st ON q.q1 = st.q1
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.code;

WITH race_1995_japan AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1995 AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
), q1_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1, d.forename, d.surname
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN race_1995_japan r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1 = (SELECT MIN(q1) FROM q1_times)
;

WITH season_2010_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2010
),

lucas_quals AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.position AS lucas_position
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN season_2010_races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas' AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
),

all_quals_in_2010 AS (
    SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.position
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN season_2010_races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
),

qualify_ahead_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.driverId) AS drivers_outqualified
    FROM lucas_quals l
    JOIN all_quals_in_2010 a ON l.raceId = a.raceId
    WHERE l.lucas_position < a.position
)

SELECT drivers_outqualified FROM qualify_ahead_counts;

WITH Italian_2017_race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
Q2_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q2
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN Italian_2017_race r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest_Q2_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(q2) AS min_q2
  FROM Q2_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM Q2_times q2
JOIN fastest_Q2_time fqt ON q2.q2 = fqt.min_q2
JOIN drivers d ON q2.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH italian_gp_runnerups AS (
    SELECT d.forename
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM italian_gp_runnerups
GROUP BY forename
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, forename ASC;

WITH RaceInfo AS (
  SELECT raceId, date, time
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
WinnerInfo AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, r.time AS raceTime
  FROM results r
  JOIN RaceInfo ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
  WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
),
WinnerDetails AS (
  SELECT d.forename, d.surname, w.raceTime, d.url, ri.date, ri.time AS startTime
  FROM WinnerInfo w
  JOIN drivers d ON w.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN RaceInfo ri ON 1=1
),
FinishTimeCalc AS (
  SELECT
    forename,
    surname,
    url,
    datetime(date || ' ' || startTime) AS raceStartDateTime,
    raceTime,
    substr(raceTime, 1, instr(raceTime, ':')-1) AS hours,
    substr(raceTime, instr(raceTime, ':')+1, instr(substr(raceTime, instr(raceTime, ':')+1), ':') - 1) AS minutes,
    substr(raceTime, instr(raceTime, ':')+instr(substr(raceTime, instr(raceTime, ':')+1), ':')) AS seconds_milli
  FROM WinnerDetails
),
FinalResult AS (
  SELECT
    forename,
    surname,
    url,
    time(
      raceStartDateTime,
      printf('+%d hours', cast(hours as integer)),
      printf('+%d minutes', cast(minutes as integer)),
      printf('+%f seconds', cast(seconds_milli as float))
    ) AS localFinishTime
  FROM FinishTimeCalc
)
SELECT forename, surname, localFinishTime, url
FROM FinalResult;

WITH q2_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driverId
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = 981
      AND q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND q2 != ''
), q3_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT driverId
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId = 981
      AND q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND q3 != ''
)
SELECT d.driverRef AS reference, d.nationality, d.dob AS birthday
FROM q2_drivers q2
JOIN drivers d ON q2.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q2.driverId NOT IN (SELECT driverId FROM q3_drivers);

WITH italian_2017_race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT driverId, q2
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM italian_2017_race) AND q2 IS NOT NULL
),
second_fastest_time AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q2
  FROM q2_times
  ORDER BY q2 ASC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q2_times q
JOIN second_fastest_time s ON q.q2 = s.q2
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH MaxPitStop AS (
  SELECT MAX(duration) AS max_duration
  FROM pitStops
),
LongestPitStops AS (
  SELECT pitStops.raceId, pitStops.driverId, pitStops.duration
  FROM pitStops
  JOIN MaxPitStop ON pitStops.duration = MaxPitStop.max_duration
),
RaceDetails AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId, r.year
  FROM races r
  JOIN LongestPitStops lps ON r.raceId = lps.raceId
),
CircuitDetails AS (
  SELECT c.circuitId, c.name AS racetrack_name, c.location, c.country
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN RaceDetails rd ON c.circuitId = rd.circuitId
)
SELECT cd.racetrack_name, cd.location, cd.country, rd.year AS season_year, lps.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM LongestPitStops lps
JOIN RaceDetails rd ON lps.raceId = rd.raceId
JOIN CircuitDetails cd ON rd.circuitId = cd.circuitId
ORDER BY cd.racetrack_name, rd.year;

WITH born_80s_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'
),
q3_lap_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS q3_lap_count
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE q3 != '' AND driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM born_80s_drivers)
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(q3_lap_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_q3_lap_times
FROM born_80s_drivers d
LEFT JOIN q3_lap_counts q ON d.driverId = q.driverId;

WITH DriversWithoutCode AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename
  FROM drivers
  WHERE code IS NULL
),
FirstNameDuplicates AS (
  SELECT forename
  FROM drivers
  GROUP BY forename
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
TargetDrivers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId
  FROM DriversWithoutCode d
  JOIN FirstNameDuplicates f ON d.forename = f.forename
),
QualifyingTimes AS (
  SELECT driverId, q1
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE q1 IS NOT NULL
),
TimesMs AS (
  SELECT driverId,
  (CAST(substr(q1,1,1) AS INTEGER)*60000 +
   CAST(substr(q1,3,2) AS INTEGER)*1000 +
   CAST(substr(q1,6,3) AS INTEGER)) AS q1_ms
  FROM QualifyingTimes
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM TimesMs t
JOIN TargetDrivers td ON t.driverId = td.driverId
WHERE t.q1_ms < 120000

WITH RobertDrivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, driverRef
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Robert'
),
LapRaceDrivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId, raceId
  FROM lapTimes
),
RobertLapRaces AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, r.raceId
  FROM LapRaceDrivers r
  INNER JOIN RobertDrivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
),
RaceResultsWithPoints AS (
  SELECT rr.driverId, rr.raceId, rr.points
  FROM results rr
  INNER JOIN RobertLapRaces rl ON rr.driverId = rl.driverId AND rr.raceId = rl.raceId
)
SELECT d.driverRef AS driver_reference, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM RobertDrivers d
JOIN RaceResultsWithPoints r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverRef
ORDER BY total_points DESC;

WITH french_gp AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.date
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE c.name LIKE '%French Grand Prix%'
    AND r.year >= 1990
),
fastest_laps AS (
  SELECT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
  FROM lapTimes lt
  JOIN french_gp fg ON lt.raceId = fg.raceId
  GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
slow_fastest_laps AS (
  SELECT fl.raceId, fl.driverId, fl.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM fastest_laps fl
  WHERE fl.fastest_lap_ms > 90000
),
drivers_info AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
  FROM drivers d
),
results AS (
  SELECT fg.date, d.forename, d.surname, fl.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM french_gp fg
  LEFT JOIN slow_fastest_laps fl ON fg.raceId = fl.raceId
  LEFT JOIN drivers_info d ON fl.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT date,
       forename,
       surname,
       CASE
         WHEN fastest_lap_ms IS NOT NULL THEN
           printf('%d:%06.3f',
                  fastest_lap_ms / 60000,
                  (fastest_lap_ms % 60000) / 1000.0)
         ELSE NULL
       END AS fastest_lap
FROM results
ORDER BY date ASC, surname ASC NULLS LAST, forename ASC NULLS LAST;

WITH italian_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Italian'
), 
q3_lap_times AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q3 AS q3_lap_time
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN italian_drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), 
fastest_q3 AS (
    SELECT MIN(q3_lap_time) AS fastest_q3_time
    FROM q3_lap_times
)

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3_lap_time
FROM q3_lap_times q
JOIN italian_drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN fastest_q3 f ON q.q3_lap_time = f.fastest_q3_time
ORDER BY d.forename, d.surname
LIMIT 1000;

WITH SecondFastestLapDrivers AS (
    SELECT rl.driverId
    FROM (
        SELECT raceId, driverId, lap, time,
               RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceId ORDER BY time) AS lapRank
        FROM lapTimes
    ) rl
    WHERE rl.lapRank = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS CountYoungerDrivers
FROM SecondFastestLapDrivers sfd
JOIN drivers d ON sfd.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

WITH ItalianGP AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017
    AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
), Q3Times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, MIN(CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)*60000 + CAST(substr(q.q3, 4, 2) AS INTEGER)*1000 + CAST(substr(q.q3, 7) AS INTEGER)) as fastest_q3_time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN ItalianGP i ON q.raceId = i.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY q.driverId
), FastestQ3Time AS (
  SELECT MIN(fastest_q3_time) AS fastest_time
  FROM Q3Times
)
SELECT d.driverRef
FROM Q3Times q
JOIN FastestQ3Time f ON q.fastest_q3_time = f.fastest_time
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH PeterWinners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE d.forename = 'Peter' AND r.positionOrder = 1
),
JohnWinners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE d.forename = 'John' AND r.positionOrder = 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PeterWinners) AS PeterWins,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JohnWinners) AS JohnWins;

WITH Q3_times AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, q.driverId, q.Q3 AS Q3_time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE q.Q3 IS NOT NULL
),

fastest_times AS (
  SELECT raceId, MIN(Q3_time) AS fastest_Q3_time
  FROM Q3_times
  GROUP BY raceId
),

fastest_drivers AS (
  SELECT qt.driverId
  FROM Q3_times qt
  JOIN fastest_times ft ON qt.raceId = ft.raceId AND qt.Q3_time = ft.fastest_Q3_time
)

SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM fastest_drivers fd
JOIN drivers d ON fd.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH FastestLapConstructors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.constructorId
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.fastestLap != 0  -- fastestLap indicates the lap that was fastest; constructorId credited if not 0
),
NationalityFastestLapCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.nationality,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId) AS fastest_lap_constructors
    FROM constructors c
    LEFT JOIN FastestLapConstructors flc ON c.constructorId = flc.constructorId
    WHERE flc.constructorId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.nationality
),
AllNationalities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT nationality FROM constructors
)
SELECT 
    an.nationality,
    COALESCE(nflc.fastest_lap_constructors, 0) AS fastest_lap_constructors
FROM AllNationalities an
LEFT JOIN NationalityFastestLapCounts nflc ON an.nationality = nflc.nationality
ORDER BY an.nationality;

WITH AustralianDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'Australian'
),
QualifiedRaces AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year
    FROM races r
    JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
    WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
      AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM AustralianDrivers)
      AND ds.position < 20
    GROUP BY r.raceId, r.year
),
PitStopsForQualifiedRaces AS (
    SELECT ps.*
    FROM pitStops ps
    WHERE ps.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM QualifiedRaces)
)
SELECT qr.year AS season_year, COUNT(psfqr.raceId) AS total_pit_stops
FROM QualifiedRaces qr
LEFT JOIN PitStopsForQualifiedRaces psfqr ON qr.raceId = psfqr.raceId
GROUP BY qr.year
ORDER BY qr.year;

WITH race_ids_1995 AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1995
),
qualifying_times AS (
    SELECT driverId, q1
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race_ids_1995)
      AND q1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS num_drivers
FROM qualifying_times
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 4) AS FLOAT) > 120.000;

WITH september_2016_races AS (
  SELECT raceId, name AS race_name, circuitId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2016 AND strftime('%m', date) = '09'
),
pit_times AS (
  SELECT p.raceId, p.driverId, p.duration
  FROM pitStops p
  JOIN september_2016_races sr ON p.raceId = sr.raceId
),
fastest_pit_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(duration) AS min_duration
  FROM pit_times
),
fastest_pits AS (
  SELECT pt.*
  FROM pit_times pt
  JOIN fastest_pit_time fpt ON pt.duration = fpt.min_duration
),
driver_info AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name
  FROM drivers
),
circuit_info AS (
  SELECT circuitId, name AS circuit_name, location
  FROM circuits
)

SELECT di.full_name, fp.duration AS pit_stop_time, sr.race_name, ci.circuit_name, ci.location
FROM fastest_pits fp
JOIN driver_info di ON fp.driverId = di.driverId
JOIN september_2016_races sr ON fp.raceId = sr.raceId
JOIN circuit_info ci ON sr.circuitId = ci.circuitId
ORDER BY pit_stop_time;

WITH WinningDrivers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, d.dob
  FROM drivers d
  INNER JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
  GROUP BY d.driverId
),
OldestWinningDriver AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality, dob
  FROM WinningDrivers
  WHERE dob = (SELECT MIN(dob) FROM WinningDrivers)
  ORDER BY forename, surname
  LIMIT 1
),
FirstWin AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, ra.name AS raceName, ra.date
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver)
    AND r.positionOrder = 1
  ORDER BY ra.date ASC, ra.name ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
CareerStarts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS totalStarts
  FROM results
  WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver)
  GROUP BY driverId
)

SELECT 
  ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS fullName,
  ow.nationality,
  fw.raceName,
  fw.date AS firstWinDate,
  cs.totalStarts
FROM OldestWinningDriver ow
JOIN FirstWin fw ON ow.driverId = fw.driverId
JOIN CareerStarts cs ON ow.driverId = cs.driverId;

WITH canadian_races AS (
    SELECT ra.raceId
    FROM races ra
    JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE ra.name LIKE '%Canadian Grand Prix%'
),
accident_statuses AS (
    SELECT statusId
    FROM status
    WHERE status LIKE '%accident%'
      AND status NOT LIKE '%killed%'
),
accident_results AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId
    FROM results r
    JOIN accident_statuses s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE r.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM canadian_races)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS race_count
FROM accident_results

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.constructorId, q.q2 AS q2_time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN race_info r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
q2_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    q2.driverId,
    q2.constructorId,
    q2.q2_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY q2.q2_time ASC) AS time_rank
  FROM q2_times q2
),
q2_ties_resolved AS (
  -- In case of ties in q2_time, order by grid position (grid is race start position) in ascending order
  SELECT 
    qr.driverId,
    qr.constructorId,
    qr.q2_time,
    r.grid,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY qr.q2_time ASC, r.grid ASC) AS final_rank
  FROM q2_ranked qr
  JOIN results r ON qr.driverId = r.driverId AND qr.constructorId = r.constructorId
  JOIN race_info ri ON ri.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.raceId = ri.raceId
),
second_fastest AS (
  SELECT driverId, constructorId
  FROM q2_ties_resolved
  WHERE final_rank = 2
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor
FROM second_fastest sf
JOIN drivers d ON sf.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON sf.constructorId = c.constructorId
LIMIT 1;

WITH italian_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND year = 2017
), q3_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3, d.number AS permanentNumber
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), fastest_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3) AS best_q3
  FROM q3_times
)
SELECT permanentNumber
FROM q3_times
WHERE q3 = (SELECT best_q3 FROM fastest_time);

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND year = 2017
),
q3_times AS (
  SELECT qual.driverId, d.code AS driver_code, 
         CASE 
           WHEN LENGTH(qual.q3) = 7 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(qual.q3, 1, 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(qual.q3, 3) AS FLOAT))
           WHEN LENGTH(qual.q3) = 8 THEN (CAST(SUBSTR(qual.q3, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(qual.q3, 4) AS FLOAT))
           ELSE NULL
         END AS q3_seconds,
         qual.q3
  FROM qualifying qual
  JOIN race_info ON qual.raceId = race_info.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON qual.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE qual.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest_q3 AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3_seconds) AS fastest_seconds
  FROM q3_times
)
SELECT driver_code, q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM q3_times
WHERE q3_seconds = (SELECT fastest_seconds FROM fastest_q3)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH Q3_times AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, q.driverId, q.q3, d.nationality
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), Fastest_Q3 AS (
    SELECT raceId, MIN(q3) as fastest_q3
    FROM Q3_times
    GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM Q3_times qt
JOIN Fastest_Q3 fq ON qt.raceId = fq.raceId AND qt.q3 = fq.fastest_q3;

WITH Chinese_GP_2000s AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.date, r.time
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.name LIKE '%Chinese Grand Prix%'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
Earliest_Start AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) AS earliestTime
  FROM Chinese_GP_2000s
),
Selected_Race AS (
  SELECT * FROM Chinese_GP_2000s
  WHERE time = (SELECT earliestTime FROM Earliest_Start)
  ORDER BY year DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
Runner_Up_Gap AS (
  SELECT res1.raceId, res1.positionOrder, res1.statusId, res1.time AS winner_time, res2.time AS runner_up_time
  FROM results res1
  JOIN results res2 ON res1.raceId = res2.raceId
  JOIN Selected_Race sr ON res1.raceId = sr.raceId
  WHERE res1.positionOrder = 1
  AND res2.positionOrder = 2
)
SELECT sr.year AS edition_year,
       runner_up_time AS runner_up_time,
       winner_time AS winner_time
FROM Selected_Race sr
JOIN Runner_Up_Gap rug ON sr.raceId = rug.raceId
LIMIT 1;

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
), q3_drivers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info) AND q3 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT code
FROM drivers
WHERE driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM q3_drivers)
ORDER BY code ASC;

WITH Italian2017 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
  WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND s.year = 2017
), Q3Times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN Italian2017 i ON q.raceId = i.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND
        (CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
         CAST(substr(q.q3, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
         CAST(substr(q.q3, 7) AS INTEGER)) < 98000
), DriverNumbers AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.number, d.surname
  FROM drivers d
  WHERE d.number IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT dn.number, dn.surname
FROM Q3Times q3
JOIN DriverNumbers dn ON q3.driverId = dn.driverId;

WITH RaceStartTimes AS (
  SELECT r.year, r.circuitId, c.name AS circuit_name, r.time AS start_time
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),

AggregatedStartTimes AS (
  SELECT circuit_name,
         MIN(start_time) AS earliest_time,
         MAX(start_time) AS latest_time
  FROM RaceStartTimes
  GROUP BY circuit_name
),

EarliestAndLatest AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(earliest_time) AS earliest_global,
    MAX(latest_time) AS latest_global
  FROM AggregatedStartTimes
),

EarliestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, earliest_time
  FROM AggregatedStartTimes, EarliestAndLatest
  WHERE earliest_time = earliest_global
),

LatestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuit_name, latest_time
  FROM AggregatedStartTimes, EarliestAndLatest
  WHERE latest_time = latest_global
),

TimeGap AS (
  SELECT 
    (strftime('%s', (SELECT latest_global FROM EarliestAndLatest)) - 
     strftime('%s', (SELECT earliest_global FROM EarliestAndLatest))) AS gap_seconds
)

SELECT 
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuit_name, ', ') FROM EarliestCircuits) AS earliest_circuits,
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuit_name, ', ') FROM LatestCircuits) AS latest_circuits,
  (SELECT gap_seconds FROM TimeGap) AS gap_seconds
;

WITH DriverFastestLaps AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    d.dob,
    MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS maxFastestLapSpeed
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId

)

ORDER BY maxFastestLapSpeed DESC, dob, surname
LIMIT 3;

WITH Italian2017 AS (
  SELECT q.*, d.driverRef
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId

),
Eliminated AS (

)
SELECT driverRef, q1 as first_segment_time

ORDER BY q1 DESC, driverId ASC

WITH target_race AS (

  FROM races r
  JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year

), withdrawn_drivers AS (

)
SELECT withdrew_count FROM withdrawn_drivers;

WITH race_participants AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 1957 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')
),
classified_finishers AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 1957 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')
      AND statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
)
SELECT ROUND((CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) FROM classified_finishers) AS FLOAT) / 
              CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) FROM race_participants) AS FLOAT)) * 100, 2) AS percentage_classified_finishers
;

WITH fall_events AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name
    FROM event
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
),
attendance_counts AS (
    SELECT fe.event_id, fe.event_name, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
    FROM fall_events fe
    LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = fe.event_id
    GROUP BY fe.event_id, fe.event_name
),
womens_soccer AS (
    SELECT attendance_count
    FROM attendance_counts
    WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
    LIMIT 1
),
average_attendance AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendance_count), 1) as avg_attendance
    FROM attendance_counts
)
SELECT
    (SELECT attendance_count FROM womens_soccer) AS womens_soccer_attendance,
    (SELECT avg_attendance FROM average_attendance) AS average_fall_attendance,
    CASE
        WHEN (SELECT attendance_count FROM womens_soccer) > (SELECT avg_attendance FROM average_attendance) THEN 'more'
        WHEN (SELECT attendance_count FROM womens_soccer) < (SELECT avg_attendance FROM average_attendance) THEN 'fewer'
        ELSE 'equal'
    END AS verdict
;

WITH CollegeDepartments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),

DepartmentMajors AS (
  SELECT department, major_name
  FROM major
  WHERE department IN (SELECT department FROM CollegeDepartments)
),

CollegeMembers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major AS major
  FROM member
  WHERE link_to_major IN (SELECT major_name FROM DepartmentMajors)
),

MembersPerMajor AS (
  SELECT link_to_major AS major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
)

SELECT 
  dm.department AS department_name,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT dm.major_name) AS majors_offered,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cm.major IS NOT NULL THEN dm.major_name ELSE NULL END) AS majors_held,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mpm.member_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM DepartmentMajors dm
LEFT JOIN CollegeMembers cm ON dm.major_name = cm.major
LEFT JOIN MembersPerMajor mpm ON dm.major_name = mpm.major
GROUP BY dm.department
ORDER BY dm.department;

WITH MemberExpenses AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member AS member_id
  FROM expense
  WHERE cost > 50
), 
MemberBudgetTotals AS (
  SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(b.remaining) AS total_remaining
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE e.cost > 50
  GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, 
       ROUND(COALESCE(mbt.total_remaining, 0), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM member m
JOIN MemberExpenses me ON m.member_id = me.member_id
LEFT JOIN MemberBudgetTotals mbt ON m.member_id = mbt.member_id
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name, m.first_name;

WITH football_attendees AS (

  FROM attendance

),
dues_collected AS (

)

SELECT SUM(d.total_dues) AS total_membership_dues_collected

WITH tyler_major AS (

    FROM member
    WHERE first_name = 'Tyler' AND last_name = 'Hewitt'
),
college_of_tyler AS (

),
college_majors AS (
    SELECT major_id, major_name

),
majors_with_enrolled_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major

)
SELECT

WITH BudgetEvents AS (
    SELECT event_id, event_name, location
    FROM event
    WHERE type = 'Budget'
)
SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_attended_members

WITH football_event AS (
  SELECT event_id
  FROM event
  WHERE event_name = 'Football game'
), football_attendees AS (
  SELECT a.link_to_member
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN football_event fe ON a.link_to_event = fe.event_id
), major_counts AS (
  SELECT maj.major_name, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count

  JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id

SELECT mc.major_name, mc.attendee_count

WHERE mc.attendee_count = max_count.max_attendee
ORDER BY mc.major_name
;

WITH event_attendance AS (
  SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_expenses AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event AS event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS total_water_spent

  WHERE b.category = 'water'
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT

  ROUND(COALESCE(w.total_water_spent, 0) * 1.0 / ea.attendee_count, 2) AS dollar_per_attendee

JOIN event_attendance ea ON e.event_id = ea.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_expenses w ON e.event_id = w.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_date, e.event_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH humanities_social_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM member m
  JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  WHERE ma.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
)
SELECT

;

Latest_date AS (

All_expenses_on_latest_date AS (

WITH mu215_events AS (

category_members AS (

WITH major_counts AS (

WITH pizza_events AS (

),
pizza_budget_ids AS (

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted_amount

FoodPurchases AS (

WITH ApprovedOctoberExpenses AS (

),
ItemCosts AS (
