    exp.expense_description AS item_name,
    b.category AS budget_category,
    SUM(exp.cost) AS total_cost
  FROM ApprovedOctoberExpenses exp
  JOIN budget b ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  GROUP BY exp.expense_description, b.category
)
SELECT item_name, budget_category, total_cost
FROM ItemCosts
ORDER BY budget_category, item_name;

WITH sacha_expenses AS (
  SELECT expense_description
  FROM expense
  WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison')
)
SELECT expense_description AS item, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM sacha_expenses
GROUP BY expense_description
ORDER BY times_bought DESC;

WITH purchase_details AS (
    SELECT 
        link_to_member AS member_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT expense_description) AS kinds_count,
        SUM(cost) AS total_spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', expense_date) IN ('2019-10', '2019-11')
    GROUP BY link_to_member
), max_kinds AS (
    SELECT MAX(kinds_count) AS max_kind_count FROM purchase_details
)
SELECT 
    m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
    pd.kinds_count,
    pd.total_spending
FROM purchase_details pd
JOIN max_kinds mk ON pd.kinds_count = mk.max_kind_count
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = pd.member_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.link_to_major) AS different_majors_count
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.department = 'Political Science'

WITH MarvelPowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
    FROM superhero su
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON su.publisher_id = p.id
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON su.id = hp.hero_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
DCPowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id, hp.power_id
    FROM superhero su
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON su.publisher_id = p.id
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON su.id = hp.hero_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
UniqueMarvelPowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    WHERE power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM MarvelPowers)
    AND power_id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM DCPowers)
),
MarvelUniqueHeroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM UniqueMarvelPowers)
),
MarvelUniqueHeroesWithHeight AS (
    SELECT su.id AS hero_id, su.height_cm
    FROM superhero su
    WHERE su.id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM MarvelUniqueHeroes)
    AND su.height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
FROM MarvelUniqueHeroesWithHeight;

WITH strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
  WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
),
strength_hero_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN strength_heroes sh ON hp.hero_id = sh.hero_id
),
powers_with_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT sp.id
  FROM superpower sp
  WHERE sp.id IN (SELECT power_id FROM strength_hero_powers)
),
powers_with_non_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM strength_heroes)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS exclusive_strength_powers_count
FROM powers_with_strength_heroes pws
WHERE pws.id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM powers_with_non_strength_heroes);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 1) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_alignment_heroes_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad')

WITH intelligence_attr AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM attribute
  WHERE attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
), abomination_intelligence AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value AS intelligence_score
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN superhero sh ON ha.hero_id = sh.id
  JOIN intelligence_attr ia ON ha.attribute_id = ia.id
  WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
), intelligence_match AS (
  SELECT ha.hero_id
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN intelligence_attr ia ON ha.attribute_id = ia.id
  JOIN abomination_intelligence ai ON ha.attribute_value = ai.intelligence_score
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(sh.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero sh
WHERE sh.id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM intelligence_match)
  AND sh.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH BlueHairedHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.gender_id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE c.colour LIKE '%blue%'
), HeroPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power hp
  GROUP BY hp.hero_id
  HAVING COUNT(hp.power_id) >= 10
), BlueHairedHeroesWithPowers AS (
  SELECT b.gender_id, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
  FROM BlueHairedHeroes b
  JOIN HeroPowerCounts hpc ON b.id = hpc.hero_id
  GROUP BY b.gender_id
), GenderNames AS (
  SELECT id, gender FROM gender
)
SELECT g.gender AS gender, COALESCE(bh.hero_count, 0) AS blue_haired_hero_count_with_10_or_more_powers
FROM GenderNames g
LEFT JOIN BlueHairedHeroesWithPowers bh ON g.id = bh.gender_id
WHERE g.gender IN ('male', 'female');

WITH hulk_strength AS (
  SELECT hp.attribute_value AS strength
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN hero_attribute hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  JOIN attribute a ON hp.attribute_id = a.id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON hp.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
AND hp.attribute_value = (SELECT strength FROM hulk_strength)
AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH RankedHeroes AS (
  SELECT 
    sh.id,
    sh.superhero_name,
    sh.height_cm,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sh.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
  FROM superhero sh
),
TopTenOrTies AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM RankedHeroes
  WHERE height_rank <= (SELECT height_rank FROM RankedHeroes WHERE height_rank = 10 LIMIT 1)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS distinct_superpower_count
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN TopTenOrTies t ON hp.hero_id = t.id;

WITH a_bomb_publisher AS (
    SELECT p.id AS publisher_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE s.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_race_character_count
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM a_bomb_publisher)
AND s.race_id IS NULL;

WITH MaleGodEternalHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
  WHERE g.gender = 'Male' AND (r.race = 'God' OR r.race = 'Eternal')
), HeroPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT s.id AS hero_id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero s
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE s.id IN (SELECT id FROM MaleGodEternalHeroes)
  GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS avg_superpowers
FROM HeroPowerCounts;

WITH CryokinesisHolders AS (
  SELECT hero_id
  FROM hero_power
  INNER JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
  WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Cryokinesis'
),
SharedHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN CryokinesisHolders ch ON hp.power_id IN (SELECT power_id FROM hero_power WHERE hero_id = ch.hero_id)
),
HeroPowerCount AS (
  SELECT hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power
  WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM SharedHeroes)
  GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS average_powers FROM HeroPowerCount;

WITH a_bomb_group AS (
  SELECT race_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
), group_members AS (
  SELECT s.height_cm
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN a_bomb_group ag ON s.race_id = ag.race_id
  WHERE s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) AS avg_height_cm
FROM group_members;

WITH FemaleHeroRaces AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id
  FROM superhero
  JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
  WHERE gender.gender = 'female'
  AND superhero.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
NonFemaleRaces AS (
  SELECT id AS race_id
  FROM race
  WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT race_id FROM FemaleHeroRaces)
)
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM NonFemaleRaces) AND weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher p
JOIN superhero sh ON p.id = sh.publisher_id
WHERE sh.height_cm > 200;

WITH NonDCGoodHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE a.alignment = 'Good' AND p.publisher_name != 'DC Comics'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_non_dc_good_heroes FROM NonDCGoodHeroes;

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
),
heroes_of_that_publisher AS (
  SELECT id, eye_colour_id, publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
    AND eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
),
distinct_eye_colours_other_publishers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE publisher_id IS NOT NULL
    AND publisher_id != (SELECT publisher_id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
    AND eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM heroes_of_that_publisher h
WHERE h.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM distinct_eye_colours_other_publishers);

WITH target_publisher AS (
  SELECT s.publisher_id
  FROM superhero s
  WHERE s.full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
), 
publisher_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.race_id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN target_publisher tp ON s.publisher_id = tp.publisher_id
  WHERE s.race_id IS NOT NULL
), 
race_counts AS (
  SELECT r.race AS race_name, COUNT(*) AS hero_count
  FROM publisher_heroes ph
  JOIN race r ON ph.race_id = r.id
  GROUP BY r.race
), 
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(hero_count) AS max_hero_count
  FROM race_counts
)
SELECT rc.race_name, rc.hero_count
FROM race_counts rc, max_count
WHERE rc.hero_count = max_count.max_hero_count
ORDER BY rc.race_name;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(superhero.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_female_weight_kg
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' AND superhero.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH hero_intelligence AS (
  SELECT ha.hero_id, ha.attribute_value AS intelligence_score
  FROM hero_attribute ha
  JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
  WHERE a.attribute_name = 'intelligence'
), hero_with_powers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
  WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super speed', 'death touch')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(hi.intelligence_score), 1) AS avg_intelligence
FROM hero_intelligence hi
JOIN hero_with_powers hwp ON hi.hero_id = hwp.hero_id
WHERE hi.intelligence_score IS NOT NULL;

WITH hero_genders AS (
  SELECT s.id, g.gender AS gender_name
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
),
heroes_with_full_name AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  WHERE s.id IN (SELECT id FROM hero_genders WHERE gender_name = 'Male')
     OR (s.id IN (SELECT id FROM hero_genders WHERE gender_name = 'Female') AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL)
),
power_count AS (
  SELECT h.id, h.gender_name, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS powers
  FROM hero_genders h
  LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE h.id IN (SELECT id FROM heroes_with_full_name)
  GROUP BY h.id, h.gender_name
)
SELECT 
  gender_name, 
  ROUND(AVG(powers), 2) AS avg_powers
FROM power_count
GROUP BY gender_name;

WITH green_skinned_villains AS (
    SELECT s.height_cm, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
    WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
      AND c.colour = 'Green'
      AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
      AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 2) AS avg_height_cm,
  ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM green_skinned_villains;

WITH george_lucas_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
    AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM george_lucas_heroes;

WITH FemaleGoodSuperheroes AS (
  SELECT s.weight_kg
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
    AND a.alignment = 'Good'
    AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM FemaleGoodSuperheroes;

WITH lightest_heroes AS (
    SELECT weight_kg
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY weight_kg ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
heroes_with_lightest_weight AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg = (SELECT weight_kg FROM lightest_heroes)
),
hero_power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(power_count), 0) AS max_power_count
FROM hero_power_counts
WHERE hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM heroes_with_lightest_weight);

WITH neutral_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_neutral_known_full_name
FROM neutral_heroes nh
JOIN superhero s ON nh.id = s.id
WHERE s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND s.full_name != ''

WITH BrownHairedHeroes AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE hair_colour_id = (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown')
), EyeColoursWithBrownHair AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eye_colour_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM BrownHairedHeroes)
), NonBrownHairHeroes AS (
  SELECT eye_colour_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE hair_colour_id != (SELECT id FROM colour WHERE colour = 'Brown')
)
SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour, COUNT(*) AS non_brown_hair_count
FROM NonBrownHairHeroes nh
JOIN colour c ON nh.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE nh.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT eye_colour_id FROM EyeColoursWithBrownHair)
GROUP BY nh.eye_colour_id
ORDER BY non_brown_hair_count DESC, eye_colour ASC;

WITH FullNamedMarvelHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, a.alignment
  FROM superhero s
  LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
    AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND s.full_name != ''
), TotalCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM FullNamedMarvelHeroes
), GoodCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS good FROM FullNamedMarvelHeroes WHERE alignment = 'Good'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * good / total, 2) AS percentage_good
FROM TotalCount, GoodCount;

WITH marvel_superheroes AS (
  SELECT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
marvel_with_power AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM marvel_superheroes)
),
marvel_with_power_and_good AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN superhero s2 ON hp.hero_id = s2.id
  JOIN alignment a ON s2.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE hp.hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM marvel_superheroes)
    AND a.alignment = 'Good'
)
SELECT ROUND((CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_with_power_and_good) AS FLOAT) / 
              (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM marvel_with_power)) * 100, 2) AS percentage_good
;

WITH superhero_eye_weight AS (
  SELECT s.id, c.colour AS eye_colour
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour = 'No Colour' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_colour_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour = 'blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blue_count
  FROM superhero_eye_weight
)
SELECT no_colour_count - blue_count AS difference
FROM counts;

WITH PatientWithUA AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Laboratory.UA
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.UA IS NOT NULL
),
UpperLimitPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID, SEX
  FROM PatientWithUA
  WHERE (SEX = 'male' AND UA > 8.0) OR (SEX = 'female' AND UA > 6.5)
)
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM UpperLimitPatients;

WITH PositiveCRP_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.CRP LIKE '+%'
), NoDescription_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Description IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS DistinctPatients
FROM PositiveCRP_Patients p
JOIN NoDescription_Patients d ON p.ID = d.ID;

WITH NormalAntiScl70Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
    AND (l.SC170 = 'negative' OR l.SC170 = '0')
), PatientsWithNonNullSymptom AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_female_patients
FROM NormalAntiScl70Patients n
WHERE n.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithNonNullSymptom);

WITH AntiRNPMax AS (
  SELECT
    P.ID AS patient_id,
    P.SEX,
    P.Birthday,
    L.Date AS lab_test_date,
    L.RNP AS anti_rnp_result,
    L.T_BIL AS total_bilirubin
  FROM Patient P
  JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
  WHERE L.RNP IS NOT NULL
),
MaxAntiRNP AS (
  SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_result) AS max_anti_rnp FROM AntiRNPMax
),
MaxAntiRNPTests AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM AntiRNPMax
  WHERE anti_rnp_result = (SELECT max_anti_rnp FROM MaxAntiRNP)
),
MaxTotalBilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS max_tbil FROM MaxAntiRNPTests
)
SELECT
  lab_test_date,
  patient_id,
  SEX,
  Birthday,
  total_bilirubin
FROM MaxAntiRNPTests
WHERE total_bilirubin = (SELECT max_tbil FROM MaxTotalBilirubin)
ORDER BY patient_id, lab_test_date
;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS PatientID, p.Birthday
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
    AND p.ID IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
        FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
    )
),
raised_rnp AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS PatientID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.RNP != 'negative' 
    AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
    GROUP BY p.ID
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_raised_rnp_count
FROM thrombosis_patients
WHERE PatientID NOT IN (SELECT PatientID FROM raised_rnp);

WITH OutpatientFollowed AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission LIKE '-%'
),
AbnormalAntiSSA AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA IS NOT NULL AND SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
PatientsOfInterest AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM OutpatientFollowed
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM AbnormalAntiSSA)
),
MaxRNP AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS max_titer
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsOfInterest) AND RNP IS NOT NULL AND RNP != ''
)
SELECT L.ID AS Patient_ID, CAST(L.RNP AS REAL) AS Anti_RNP_titer
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN PatientsOfInterest P ON L.ID = P.ID
JOIN MaxRNP M ON CAST(L.RNP AS REAL) = M.max_titer
WHERE L.RNP IS NOT NULL AND L.RNP != ''
;

WITH mctd_only_patients AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  GROUP BY p.ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.Diagnosis) = 1 AND MAX(p.Diagnosis) = 'MCTD'
),
platelet_normal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
),
rnp_high AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM mctd_only_patients m
JOIN platelet_normal pn ON m.ID = pn.ID
JOIN rnp_high r ON m.ID = r.ID;

WITH never_examined AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.ID IS NULL
), lab_counts AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, p.ID, COUNT(DISTINCT l.Date) AS test_date_count
  FROM never_examined p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX, p.ID
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  ROUND(AVG(test_date_count), 2) AS avg_laboratory_test_dates
FROM lab_counts
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH HematocritStatus AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN HCT <= 29 OR HCT >= 52 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_non_normal_hematocrit
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
AntiRibonuclearProteinStatus AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 16 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_high_anti_rnp
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN HematocritStatus h ON p.ID = h.patient_id
JOIN AntiRibonuclearProteinStatus a ON p.ID = a.patient_id
WHERE h.has_non_normal_hematocrit = 1 AND a.has_high_anti_rnp = 1;

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS FLOAT)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value
FROM Laboratory
WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND RNP != ''

WITH DiagnosedPatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis IN ('RA', 'SJS')
    AND e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.ID
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis = 'RA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis = 'SJS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND COUNT(DISTINCT e.Diagnosis) = 2
),
LabSummary AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
  FROM Laboratory l
  GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.patient_id) FILTER (WHERE ls.has_normal_platelet = 1) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.patient_id) FILTER (WHERE ls.has_normal_platelet = 0 OR ls.has_normal_platelet IS NULL) AS patients_without_normal_platelet
FROM DiagnosedPatients dp
LEFT JOIN LabSummary ls ON dp.patient_id = ls.patient_id;

WITH LowAlbuminPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ALB < 3.5
)
SELECT Patient.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS Patient_Count
FROM Patient
JOIN LowAlbuminPatients ON Patient.ID = LowAlbuminPatients.Patient_ID
GROUP BY Patient.SEX
ORDER BY Patient.SEX;

WITH ProteinuriaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE 
    (CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 300) OR
    (l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4'))
),
AgesIn1999 AS (
  SELECT ID, 
         CAST(strftime('%Y', '1999-01-01') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_1999
  FROM ProteinuriaPatients
  WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(age_1999) AS average_age_1999
FROM AgesIn1999;

WITH HighMeasurementPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 32
)
SELECT
  p.SEX AS gender,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN HighMeasurementPatients hmp ON p.ID = hmp.ID
GROUP BY p.SEX;

WITH AgeCalculation AS (
  SELECT 
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    (strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS age_at_test,
    Laboratory.RNP AS RNP_result
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.RNP != 'negative' AND CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
)
SELECT MIN(age_at_test) AS youngest_age
FROM AgeCalculation;

WITH PsoriaticPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'Psoriatic arthritis'
),
LaboratoryCounts AS (
    SELECT ID AS patient_id, COUNT(*) AS lab_test_count
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT patient_id FROM PsoriaticPatients)
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(lab_test_count), 0) FROM LaboratoryCounts) AS total_lab_tests,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PsoriaticPatients WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM LaboratoryCounts)) AS patients_with_no_tests
;

WITH PatientsWithThrombosisIn1997 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS PatientID
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  WHERE Examination.[Examination Date] BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    AND Examination.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL
    AND Examination.Thrombosis != 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS thrombosis_cohort_patient_count
FROM PatientsWithThrombosisIn1997;

WITH SLE_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
Thrombotic_Episodes AS (
  SELECT Symptoms
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
    AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SLE_Patients)
    AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(Symptoms) != ''
)
SELECT Symptoms AS symptom
FROM Thrombotic_Episodes
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ThrombosisExams AS (
    SELECT ID, Diagnosis
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 1
),
SLEInThrombosisExams AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 1 AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SLEInThrombosisExams) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ThrombosisExams), 2) AS percentage_SLE_in_thrombosis
;

WITH NormalASTLab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31'
    AND Laboratory.GOT < 60
)
SELECT SEX, COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM NormalASTLab
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

WITH EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.LDH > 600 AND l.LDH < 800
    AND (
      (l."U-PRO" LIKE 'at least %' AND CAST(SUBSTR(l."U-PRO", 10) AS FLOAT) >= 300) OR
      (l."U-PRO" GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS FLOAT) >= 300)
    )
)
SELECT patient_id,
       CAST((JULIANDAY('2026-10-09') - JULIANDAY(Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS completed_age
FROM EligiblePatients
ORDER BY patient_id;

WITH RadUreaNormal AS (
  SELECT p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'RA'
    AND l.UN < 30
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RadUreaNormal WHERE SEX = 'F')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RadUreaNormal WHERE SEX = 'M') AS difference;

WITH Patients_OutOfRange AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5
),
Total_Patients AS (
  SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM Patient
  GROUP BY SEX
),
OutOfRange_Counts AS (
  SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS out_of_range_count
  FROM Patients_OutOfRange
  GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT t.SEX,
       COALESCE(o.out_of_range_count, 0) AS patients_with_out_of_range,
       t.total AS total_patients,
       ROUND(COALESCE(o.out_of_range_count, 0) * 100.0 / t.total, 1) AS percentage
FROM Total_Patients t
LEFT JOIN OutOfRange_Counts o ON t.SEX = o.SEX
WHERE t.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
ORDER BY t.SEX;

WITH MaxTCHO AS (
  SELECT
    p.Admission AS admission_status,
    MAX(l."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  GROUP BY p.Admission
),
MaxTCHO_Patients AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Admission AS admission_status,
    l."T-CHO"
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  JOIN MaxTCHO m ON m.admission_status = p.Admission AND m.max_tcho = l."T-CHO"
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT admission_status, "T-CHO" AS T_CHO, patient_id
FROM MaxTCHO_Patients
ORDER BY CASE admission_status WHEN '+' THEN 0 WHEN '-' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, patient_id

WITH FirstVisit1991 AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE strftime('%Y', "First Date") = '1991'
),
RNP_Levels AS (
  SELECT Laboratory.ID AS patient_id, CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_level
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
),
MaxRNPLevel AS (
  SELECT patient_id, MAX(rnp_level) AS max_rnp_level
  FROM RNP_Levels
  GROUP BY patient_id
)
SELECT f.patient_id, m.max_rnp_level AS anti_rnp_level
FROM FirstVisit1991 f
JOIN MaxRNPLevel m ON f.patient_id = m.patient_id
WHERE m.max_rnp_level = (
  SELECT MAX(max_rnp_level) FROM MaxRNPLevel
)

WITH SLE_Only_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
Abnormal_Proteinuria_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
),
Eligible_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM SLE_Only_Patients
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID
  FROM Abnormal_Proteinuria_Patients
),
CareSettings AS (
  SELECT p.ID,
    CASE
      WHEN p.Admission = 'inpatient' THEN 'Hospital'
      WHEN p.Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 'Outpatient'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS CareSetting
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Eligible_Patients)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN CareSetting = 'Hospital' THEN 1 END) AS Hospital_Admissions,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN CareSetting = 'Outpatient' THEN 1 END) AS Outpatient_Followup
FROM CareSettings
;

WITH LatestSamples AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_ID, MAX(Date) AS max_sample_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
LatestAntiScl70 AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_ID, MAX(Date) AS max_anti_date
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
LatestAntiResults AS (
  SELECT lab.ID AS patient_ID, lab.Date, lab.SC170 AS result
  FROM Laboratory lab
  JOIN LatestAntiScl70 lat ON lab.ID = lat.patient_ID AND lab.Date = lat.max_anti_date
)
SELECT ls.patient_ID
FROM LatestSamples ls
JOIN LatestAntiResults lar ON ls.patient_ID = lar.patient_ID
WHERE ls.max_sample_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND lar.result IN ('negative', '0')

WITH SSA_Abnormal_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0', 'zero', NULL)
), Proteinuria_Positive_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" NOT IN ('negative', 'none', '', NULL)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumPatients
FROM (
  SELECT ID FROM SSA_Abnormal_Patients
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID FROM Proteinuria_Positive_Patients
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patients_with_anti_DNA_below_8
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS INTEGER) < 8;

WITH AdmittedPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission != '-'
),
PatientsWithHighAlk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Examination.ID
  FROM Examination
  JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.ALP >= 300
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patients_never_high_alk
FROM AdmittedPatients
WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithHighAlk);

WITH NormalCreatininePatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CRE < 1.5
),
AntiRNPLevels AS (
  SELECT CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) AS AntiRNPValue
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM NormalCreatininePatients)
)
SELECT MAX(AntiRNPValue) AS HighestAntiRNPValue
FROM AntiRNPLevels;

WITH SevereAnemiaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.HGB < 7.0
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 'female'
    WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 'male'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM SevereAnemiaPatients
GROUP BY sex
ORDER BY sex;

WITH FilteredTests AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) AS RNP_value
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GOT >= 60 AND RNP IS NOT NULL
), MaxValue AS (
  SELECT MAX(RNP_value) AS max_rnp
  FROM FilteredTests
)
SELECT
  ID AS laboratory_test_id,
  Date AS date_performed,
  RNP_value AS anti_ribonuclear_protein
FROM FilteredTests
WHERE RNP_value = (SELECT max_rnp FROM MaxValue);

WITH patient_filtered AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Birthday > '1980-01-01'
),

fibrinogen_abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE FG IS NOT NULL AND (FG < 150 OR FG > 450)
),

severe_proteinuria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3+', '4+')
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pf.ID) AS eligibility_count
FROM patient_filtered pf
LEFT JOIN fibrinogen_abnormal fa ON pf.ID = fa.ID
LEFT JOIN severe_proteinuria sp ON pf.ID = sp.ID
WHERE fa.ID IS NOT NULL OR sp.ID IS NOT NULL;

WITH NoSexPatients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX IS NULL
),
PatientsWithLabs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN NoSexPatients p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
PatientsWithElevatedBilirubin AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN NoSexPatients p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PatientsWithLabs) AS PatientsWithAtLeastOneLab,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PatientsWithElevatedBilirubin) AS PatientsWithElevatedBilirubinResult;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1945' AND '1989'
),
AdmittedPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission LIKE '+' || '%'
),
ExactPPatterns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Examination.ID
  FROM Examination
  JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  WHERE "ANA Pattern" = 'P'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.ID) AS admitted_females_with_exact_P
FROM FemalePatients fp
JOIN AdmittedPatients ap ON fp.ID = ap.ID
JOIN ExactPPatterns ep ON fp.ID = ep.ID;

WITH OutpatientPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS PatientID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Admission != 'inpatient'
),

AnemicPatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS PatientID
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    WHERE HGB < 10
),

EligiblePatients AS (
    SELECT PatientID
    FROM OutpatientPatients
    INTERSECT
    SELECT PatientID
    FROM AnemicPatients
),

AntiRNPLevels AS (
    SELECT ID AS PatientID, MAX(CAST(RNP AS FLOAT)) AS MaxAntiRNP
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),

MaxAntiRNPLevel AS (
    SELECT MAX(MaxAntiRNP) AS HighestLevel
    FROM AntiRNPLevels
)

SELECT a.PatientID, p.SEX, a.MaxAntiRNP
FROM AntiRNPLevels a
JOIN EligiblePatients e ON a.PatientID = e.PatientID
JOIN Patient p ON a.PatientID = p.ID
JOIN MaxAntiRNPLevel m ON a.MaxAntiRNP = m.HighestLevel
ORDER BY a.PatientID;

WITH FirstLab AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS PatientID,
    MIN(Date) AS FirstTestDate
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
FirstLabResults AS (
  SELECT
    L.ID AS PatientID,
    L.GOT,
    L.RNP
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN FirstLab F ON L.ID = F.PatientID AND L.Date = F.FirstTestDate
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PatientID) AS PatientCount
FROM FirstLabResults
WHERE GOT < 60 AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 10;

WITH LatestProteinuriaTest AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID AS patient_id,
        p.SEX AS sex,
        l.Date AS most_recent_test_date,
        l."U-PRO" AS proteinuria_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY l.Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    patient_id,
    sex,
    most_recent_test_date,
    proteinuria_level
FROM LatestProteinuriaTest
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH ElevatedAntiRNP AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE TestName = 'anti-ribonuclear protein' AND TestResult >= 16
),
NormalGPT AS (
  SELECT PatientID, MAX(TestResult) AS MaxGPT
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE TestName = 'GPT' AND TestResult < 60
  GROUP BY PatientID
),
EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT er.PatientID, ng.MaxGPT
  FROM ElevatedAntiRNP er
  INNER JOIN NormalGPT ng ON er.PatientID = ng.PatientID
),
RankedPatients AS (
  SELECT ep.PatientID, p.Birthday, ep.MaxGPT,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ep.MaxGPT DESC, ep.PatientID ASC) AS rn
  FROM EligiblePatients ep
  JOIN Patient p ON ep.PatientID = p.PatientID
)
SELECT Birthday
FROM RankedPatients
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY rn;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'female'
),
LabFiltered AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, PT, RNP
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE PT IS NOT NULL AND PT < 14 AND RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) >= 16
),
MatchedLab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM LabFiltered
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count
FROM MatchedLab
JOIN FemalePatients USING (patient_id);

WITH Inpatients AS (
  SELECT ID, Birthday, Diagnosis
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '+'
),
AntiDNALabs AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, DNA
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL
),
JoinLabsPatients AS (
  SELECT I.ID AS patient_id, I.Birthday, I.Diagnosis, L.Date AS test_date, CAST(L.DNA AS INTEGER) AS anti_DNA_level
  FROM Inpatients I
  JOIN AntiDNALabs L ON I.ID = L.ID
),
MaxLevel AS (
  SELECT MAX(anti_DNA_level) AS max_level
  FROM JoinLabsPatients
),
MaxTests AS (
  SELECT * FROM JoinLabsPatients
  WHERE anti_DNA_level = (SELECT max_level FROM MaxLevel)
)
SELECT 
  ((STRFTIME('%Y', test_date) - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday)) -
   (STRFTIME('%m-%d', test_date) < STRFTIME('%m-%d', Birthday))) AS age_at_test,
  Diagnosis,
  anti_DNA_level,
  test_date
FROM MaxTests
ORDER BY test_date
LIMIT 1;

WITH SLE_confirmed AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' ESCAPE '\\'
),
Liver_abnormalities AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE `T-BIL` >= 1.2
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN SLE_confirmed s ON p.ID = s.ID
JOIN Liver_abnormalities l ON p.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID

WITH PatientSetting AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    CASE
      WHEN Admission = 'hospital' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN Admission = 'outpatient' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS Care_Setting
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission IN ('hospital','outpatient')
),
RecentIgG AS (
  SELECT 
    ID AS Patient_ID,
    IGG,
    Date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
RecentIgGForPatients AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID, IGG, Date
  FROM RecentIgG
  WHERE rn = 1
),
Combined AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Care_Setting, r.IGG
  FROM PatientSetting p
  LEFT JOIN RecentIgGForPatients r ON p.ID = r.Patient_ID
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ID),
    1
  ) AS "admitted to the hospital"
FROM Combined
WHERE Care_Setting = 'admitted to the hospital'
UNION ALL
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ID),
    1
  ) AS "followed at the outpatient clinic"
FROM Combined
WHERE Care_Setting = 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
LIMIT 1000

WITH LatestVisit AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    MAX(Date) AS MostRecentVisit
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
StronglyPositiveRNP AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID,
    p.SEX
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN LatestVisit lv ON l.ID = lv.ID AND l.Date = lv.MostRecentVisit
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 32
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM StronglyPositiveRNP WHERE SEX = 'F') -
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM StronglyPositiveRNP WHERE SEX = 'M')
AS FemaleMinusMaleStronglyPositiveRNPAtMostRecentVisit

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
LatestRelevantLabs AS (
  SELECT L.ID, L.Date, L.RNP, L.CPK
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN FemalePatients FP ON L.ID = FP.ID
  WHERE L.Date = (
    SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.ID = L.ID
  )
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CountFemalePatients
FROM LatestRelevantLabs
WHERE CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 64 AND CPK < 250;

WITH Confirmed_SLE_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
), Inpatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Confirmed_SLE_Patients)
    AND Admission = 'Inpatient'
), Outpatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Confirmed_SLE_Patients)
    AND Admission = 'Outpatient'
), CombinedCare AS (
  SELECT ID FROM Inpatients
  UNION
  SELECT ID FROM Outpatients
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Inpatients) AS inpatient_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Outpatients) AS outpatient_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Inpatients) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CombinedCare), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
;

WITH
tl_patient_ldh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE LDH >= 500
),
tl_patient_protein AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE 
    (U_PRO LIKE '+2(100)') OR
    (CAST(CASE
      WHEN U_PRO LIKE '>=%' THEN SUBSTR(U_PRO, 3)
      ELSE U_PRO
    END AS INTEGER) >= 100)
),
tl_qualified_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM tl_patient_ldh
  INTERSECT
  SELECT ID
  FROM tl_patient_protein
)

SELECT
  p.ID AS patient_id,
  p.SEX AS sex,
  p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN tl_qualified_patients q ON p.ID = q.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH PatientsWithoutExamination AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.ID IS NULL
)
SELECT SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM PatientsWithoutExamination
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_admitted_1998
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'female'
  AND "First Date" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'
;

WITH QualifiedExaminations AS (
  SELECT
    e.ID AS examination_id,
    e.ID AS exam_id,
    e.[Examination Date] AS exam_date,
    e.Symptoms AS symptom,
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Birthday AS birth_date,
    p.Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis,
    e.Diagnosis AS exam_diagnosis
  FROM
    Examination e
  JOIN
    Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE
    e.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND
    e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
),

YoungestPatients AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    birth_date
  FROM
    QualifiedExaminations
  ORDER BY
    birth_date ASC,
    patient_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),

SelectedExam AS (
  SELECT
    exam.*
  FROM
    QualifiedExaminations exam
  JOIN
    YoungestPatients yp ON exam.patient_id = yp.patient_id
  ORDER BY
    exam.exam_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  se.symptom,
  se.patient_diagnosis
FROM
  SelectedExam se;

WITH PatientFirstVisit AS (
  SELECT ID, MIN(Description) AS first_visit_date
  FROM Patient
  GROUP BY ID
),
PatientsFebSecondHalf AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM PatientFirstVisit p
  WHERE p.first_visit_date BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
),
PatientAgeCalc AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.Birthday, 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', '1998-02-15') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
    - CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1998-02-15') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age,
    p.Diagnosis,
    p.Admission
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsFebSecondHalf)
  AND p.Admission = 'Inpatient'
)
SELECT Diagnosis
FROM PatientAgeCalc
ORDER BY age DESC, ID ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG([aCL IgM]), 1) AS avg_anti_cardiolipin_IgM
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'systemic lupus erythematosus'
  AND [Examination Date] BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND [aCL IgM] IS NOT NULL;

WITH PsoriaticArthritisPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS NumPatientsWithPsoriaticArthritis
FROM PsoriaticArthritisPatients;

WITH RBC_Low_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday, Patient.Admission
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.RBC < 3.5
),
Age_Calculation AS (
  SELECT ID, Admission,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) -
    CASE
      WHEN STRFTIME('%m%d', '2026-10-09') < STRFTIME('%m%d', Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
  FROM RBC_Low_Patients
)
SELECT Admission AS care_setting, COUNT(ID) AS patient_count, ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS avg_age
FROM Age_Calculation
GROUP BY Admission

WITH SjS_diagnosed_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
      AND e.Diagnosis = 'SjS'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_SjS_diagnosed_count
FROM SjS_diagnosed_patients;

WITH
PatientAdmissionStatus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis LIKE '%admitted%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0
),
NormalRNPResults AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP = 'negative' OR l.RNP = '0'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pas.patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM PatientAdmissionStatus pas
JOIN NormalRNPResults nr ON pas.patient_id = nr.patient_id

WITH PatientWithNormalAntiSM AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.SM = 'negative' OR l.SM = '0'
),
PatientWithoutThrombosis AS (
  SELECT e.ID
  FROM Examination e
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 0 OR e.Thrombosis IS NULL
),
PatientWithSignificantProteinuria AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE (l.[U-PRO] GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(l.[U-PRO] AS INTEGER) >= 30)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS count_patients
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN PatientWithNormalAntiSM n ON l.ID = n.ID
JOIN PatientWithoutThrombosis t ON l.ID = t.ID
JOIN PatientWithSignificantProteinuria p ON l.ID = p.ID
;

WITH PositiveAntiRNP AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
),
AgeFiltered AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID, (2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age
  FROM Patient
  WHERE (2026 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 70
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_age
FROM AgeFiltered
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PositiveAntiRNP)

WITH filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX = 'female'
    AND l.WBC > 3.5
    AND l.WBC < 9.0
    AND (CAST(l.FG AS REAL) <= 150 OR CAST(l.FG AS REAL) >= 450)
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count FROM filtered_patients;

WITH PatientsInBirthRange AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX
  FROM Patient
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
),
CPKResults AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, MAX(l.CPK) AS max_cpk
  FROM PatientsInBirthRange p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
),
PatientsNeverAboveCPK AS (
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM CPKResults
  WHERE max_cpk IS NULL OR max_cpk < 250
),
FinalGroup AS (
  SELECT p.SEX
  FROM PatientsInBirthRange p
  JOIN PatientsNeverAboveCPK n ON p.ID = n.patient_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS women_percentage
FROM FinalGroup;

WITH early_tests AS (
  SELECT
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    Patient.Birthday AS birth_date,
    Laboratory.Date AS test_date,
    Laboratory.PLT AS platelet_count,
    Laboratory."U-PRO" AS proteinuria
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
    AND Laboratory.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
    AND Laboratory."U-PRO" != '0'
    AND Laboratory."U-PRO" != '-' 
    AND Laboratory."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
), early_age_filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    patient_id
  FROM early_tests
  WHERE (strftime('%Y', test_date) - strftime('%Y', birth_date)) - (strftime('%m-%d', test_date) < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date)) < 50
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM early_age_filtered;

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
OxygenCountPerMolecule AS (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS oxygen_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'O'
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
MoleculeOxygens AS (
    SELECT sbm.molecule_id, COALESCE(ocpm.oxygen_count, 0) AS oxygen_count
    FROM SingleBondMolecules sbm
    LEFT JOIN OxygenCountPerMolecule ocpm ON sbm.molecule_id = ocpm.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM MoleculeOxygens;

WITH single_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'  -- single bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'  -- carcinogenic
), carcinogenic_single_bonds AS (
  SELECT sbc.molecule_id, sbc.single_bond_count
  FROM single_bond_counts sbc
  JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON sbc.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_carcinogenic_molecule
FROM carcinogenic_single_bonds;

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label != '-'
),
ElementOccurrences AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
  FROM atom a
  JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules ncm ON a.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
  GROUP BY a.element
),
MinOccurrences AS (
  SELECT MIN(occurrences) AS min_occurrences
  FROM ElementOccurrences
)
SELECT element
FROM ElementOccurrences
WHERE occurrences = (SELECT min_occurrences FROM MinOccurrences)
ORDER BY element;

WITH single_bond_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 'I' AND a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM single_bond_atoms)) AS iodine_atoms,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) FROM atom a WHERE a.element = 'S' AND a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM single_bond_atoms)) AS sulfur_atoms;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
),
molecules_with_fluorine AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'F'
),
carcinogenic_without_fluorine AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules
    WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecules_with_fluorine)
),
total_carcinogenic AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM carcinogenic_molecules
),
carcinogenic_no_fluorine_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_f_count FROM carcinogenic_without_fluorine
)
SELECT ROUND((CAST(no_f_count AS FLOAT) / total_count) * 100, 2) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM carcinogenic_no_fluorine_count, total_carcinogenic;

WITH BondTypeCount AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt
  FROM BondTypeCount
),
MostCommonBond AS (
  SELECT bond_type
  FROM BondTypeCount
  WHERE cnt = (SELECT max_cnt FROM MaxCount)
),
IsCarcinogenic AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT bond_type FROM MostCommonBond) AS most_common_bond_type,
  (SELECT carcinogenic FROM IsCarcinogenic) AS carcinogenic
LIMIT 1;

WITH MoleculesWithTripleBond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
MoleculesWithPOrBr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom.molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.element IN ('P', 'Br')
),
TargetMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculesWithTripleBond
  INTERSECT
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculesWithPOrBr
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM TargetMolecules);

WITH MoleculesWithSingleBond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
), AtomCounts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM MoleculesWithSingleBond)
)
SELECT ROUND((chlorine_atoms * 100.0) / total_atoms, 4) AS chlorine_atom_percentage
FROM AtomCounts;

WITH molecule_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b.bond_type) AS bond_types
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),

molecule_labels AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label FROM molecule
),

molecule_groups AS (
  SELECT
    mbt.molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN mbt.bond_types = '-' THEN 'all_single_bonds' ELSE 'not_all_single_bonds' END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule_bond_types mbt
),

carcinogenic_counts AS (
  SELECT
    mg.saturation_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ml.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ml.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM molecule_groups mg
  JOIN molecule_labels ml ON mg.molecule_id = ml.molecule_id
  GROUP BY mg.saturation_group
)

SELECT
  saturation_group,
  carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM carcinogenic_counts;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
), carbon_atoms AS (
    SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'C'
), carbon_carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.bond_type
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN carbon_atoms a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN carbon_atoms a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM carcinogenic_molecules)
      AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
      AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
) 
SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM carbon_carbon_bonds
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY bond_type;

WITH sulfur_atoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 'S' AND m.label = '+'
),
sulfur_bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.atom_id = sa.atom_id THEN c.atom_id2 ELSE c.atom_id END AS bonded_atom_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN sulfur_atoms sa ON c.atom_id = sa.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = sa.atom_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS directly_bonded_atoms_to_sulfur_in_carcinogenic
FROM sulfur_bonded_atoms;

WITH nitrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'n'
),

nitrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN nitrogen_atoms a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
),

nitrogen_bond_types AS (
  SELECT nb.molecule_id, b.bond_type
  FROM nitrogen_bonds nb
  JOIN bond b ON nb.bond_id = b.bond_id
),

molecules_with_forbidden_nitrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM nitrogen_bond_types
  WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')
),

molecules_with_nitrogen AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM nitrogen_atoms
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_molecules
FROM molecules_with_nitrogen
WHERE molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecules_with_forbidden_nitrogen_bonds)

WITH chlorine_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'cl'
), bonded_to_chlorine AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id2 AS atom_id
  FROM connected
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id AS atom_id
  FROM connected
  WHERE atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS bonded_to_chlorine_count
FROM bonded_to_chlorine;

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = 'triple'
),
counted AS (
  SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM triple_bond_molecules)
  GROUP BY label
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM counted WHERE label = '+') / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counted), 2), 0.0) AS percent_carcinogenic,
  COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT cnt FROM counted WHERE label = '-') / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counted), 2), 0.0) AS percent_non_carcinogenic
;

WITH RareElements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
CarcinogenicMoleculesRareElements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  JOIN RareElements re ON a.element = re.element
  WHERE m.label = '+'
),
ElementBondCounts AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
  WHERE a.element IN (SELECT element FROM RareElements)
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id, a.element
),
MoleculeBondCounts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, SUM(bond_count) AS total_bond_count
  FROM ElementBondCounts
  GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, total_bond_count AS bond_count
FROM MoleculeBondCounts
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM CarcinogenicMoleculesRareElements)
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS atom_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS carbon_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 END) AS chlorine_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type, a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c1 ON b.bond_id = c1.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN connected c2 ON b.bond_id = c2.bond_id AND c2.atom_id != c1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c2.atom_id = a2.atom_id
  GROUP BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type, a1.element, a2.element
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C' THEN 1 END) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double','triple') THEN 1 END) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM bond_atoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
molecule_info AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
         COALESCE(ac.atom_count, 0) AS atom_count,
         COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,
         COALESCE(ac.carbon_count, 0) AS carbon_count,
         COALESCE(ac.chlorine_count, 0) AS chlorine_count,
         COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
         COALESCE(bc.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON m.molecule_id = ac.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON m.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
  WHERE COALESCE(ac.carbon_count, 0) > 0
)
SELECT molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_count, chlorine_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY carbon_touching_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank
FROM molecule_info
ORDER BY rank, molecule_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH molecule_with_yttrium AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Y'
),
hydrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'H'
),
hydrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bond_id
  FROM connected
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM hydrogen_atoms) OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM hydrogen_atoms)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM bond
WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM hydrogen_bonds)
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule_with_yttrium);

WITH non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
),
double_or_triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules ncm ON b.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('2', '3')  -- double or triple bonds
),
bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN double_or_triple_bonds d ON c.bond_id = d.bond_id
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN a1.element = 'C' THEN a2.element
      ELSE a1.element
    END AS element
  FROM bonded_atoms b
  JOIN atom a1 ON b.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON b.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE (a1.element = 'C' OR a2.element = 'C')
    AND (a1.element != a2.element)
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM carbon_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), single_bonded_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
)
SELECT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN metal_atoms USING(molecule_id)
JOIN single_bonded_molecules USING(molecule_id)
JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules USING(molecule_id)
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH single_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id, a.element
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
),
multiple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type != '-'
),
single_only_atoms AS (
  SELECT s.atom_id, s.element
  FROM single_bond_atoms s
  LEFT JOIN multiple_bond_atoms m ON s.atom_id = m.atom_id
  WHERE m.atom_id IS NULL
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS fully_saturated_atom_count
FROM single_only_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH triple_bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
molecule_counts AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM triple_bonded_atoms
  GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element, molecule_count
FROM molecule_counts
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;
